tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /seng ge rtse pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog/ shrī na rent+ra tā rā pra tri dha shrī bha dra sya ā yurdirgha dza yantu swasti/ dpal mi'i dbang po sgrol ma rab brtan dpal bzang po tshe ring zhing bde legs su gyur cig dge legs bye ba'i dpal yon nyal 'gro'i bsti gnas ind+ra nī la'i khu ba'i 'jing na dal 'byor chu ba rab brtan zhing / /dge mtshan utpal 'thon mthing lta bu'i 'dren byed zung dang gnyis skyes gzhon nu rab tu dkar ba'i me tog rnam par bkra/ /dge ba'i ngang tshul tshad med spungs pa'i yal ga 'gro byed lo 'dab ma ra ka ltar ljang zhing mnyen pa'i zur phud can/ /dge zhing rnam par rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng la snyems pa med par kun nas kun tu rgyal gyur cig /bde legs tshigs bcad sngon du gsol nas kyang / /mi dbang khyed la snyun 'dri'i mchid 'di zhu/ /khyed sku ya mtshan stong gi dpal 'bar ba/ /nam yang bgres pa med par bzhugs lags sam/ /gang gsung gser mngal dbyangs ltar snyan pa de/ /'gag med khrims gnyis rgyal rnga sgrog lags sam/ /zab gsal spros med rdo rje'i thugs de yang / /shin tu gsal zhing brtan par 'tsho lags drangs/ /chab srid skye dgu'i dpal mgon khyod nyid ni/ /grags pa'i ba dan khor yug pha mthar son/ /mnga' 'bangs dbyar gyi 'tsho ltar gang ba la/ /'gran zla med cing bde bar skyong lags sam/ /mang thos dge sbyong spong ba'i brtul zhugs can/ /sa skyar gnas shing phyogs kun rgyu ba yi/ /skad gnyis smra ba ngur smrig cha lugs 'dzin/ /dam ba'i drin las lam bzang rab rnyed pa/ /shākya'i sras kyi rjes zhugs bdag cag kyang / /rnam smin lus kyi 'tsho ba mdangs gsal zhing / /rim gnyis rnal 'byor mchog la mi g.yel bar/ /gzhan phan chos kyi legs par 'dom pa lags/ /slar yang khyod kyi bka' drin nyer 'tsho las/ /stod phyogs sa yi thig ler myur bgrod pa'i/

/skal ba mchog tu 'gyur snyam yid la gcags/ /'on kyang yul dang dus kyis rab skal bas/ /da dung lo gnyis lo gsum de phyogs su/ /bgrod dam mi bgrod yid gnyis phyogs la 'chang / /gang ltar song kyang phyogs der mi dbang khyed/ /yab sras gtso mdzad sku yi 'tsho ba brtan/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis ma gtses zhing / /bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung ba'i nyer 'tshe las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen phyogs su grags/ /gzhan sde dpa' bskong rang srid rgyas pa'i thabs/ /zhi bas skyong zhing phun sum tshogs gyur cig /kho bo cag la'ang gcig tu thugs brtse zhing / /mchog tu brtsal ba'i khyed kyi bka' drin las/ /nye bar bskyangs pa'i sa gzhi dbang rigs rnams/ /nyid kyi brtson pas kun du bsrung ba dang / /drag zhan sne mor bkos pa thams cad kyang / /khas nyen med cing thugs kyis bzung bar mdzod/ /da lan kho bo'i lhan cig gnas pa yi/ /bhikṣu kītta shwa ra 'khor bcas rnams/ /khyed sku lta zhing chos sde rnams su yang /rnam dkar rim 'gro chos spyod sgrub pa dang / /bstan bsrung 'khor bcas mnyes pa'i mchod gtor dag /'bul ba'i ched du gtad nas bzhud pa lags/ /'phrin yig utpal dkar po'i phreng ba 'di/ /blo gros yangs pa'i pad mtsho legs 'thon nas/ /pho nya 'khor lo'i ngag gis rab bskyod de/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang mdun sar bzhud/ /chab shog ku mud ngos la spyan ras kyis/ /tsa kor rnam par g.yo ba'i mtshon byed du/ /rkang 'thung dbang po'i lo ma mchog dag la/ /tsarma'i phur mar mu tra bkod zhing mchis/ /rta ljang lha yi dbang po mchog gang de/ /bṛ ṣa'i khyim du smin drug bu mo la/ /rnam par brtson pa'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes/ /rgyun gyi dbang po'i sde nas phul ba dge/ /su bardho bārṣa pṛ thā pā la nā ma bakṣi bhai shā kha mā sa shu kla pa kā ra ti pra tha ma ti thi li khyātra// ༈ /seng ger rtse pa la gnang ba/

shrī phun tshogs 'chi med kyi brgya byin sa la 'phos pa'i stobs kyis 'khor lo sgyur ba'i dpal lha sgrol ma rab brtan rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes bka' mchid nor bu'i do shal tāmpa shaṅkha'i me tog dang bcas pa 'dren byed zag med kyi bdud rtsi rna ba'i dga' ston du gyur pas snying gi padma'i ze 'bru rab tu rgod pa'i 'dzum dkar gnyis skyes 'od zer khor yug gi pha mthar son pas 'od gsal zung 'jug gi utpa la yi skyed mos tshal nas snyan tshig mgrin pa'i gad rgyangs rnam par sgrog pa'i 'phrin yig ngang pa'i bu mo gre 'gyur stong dang ldan pas lho phyogs chu gter gyi ngogs su dal bar rgyu ba lags so/ /da sha ti thi da na// ༈ /seng ge rtse'i sde pa dad pa rab brtan la bka' shog gnang ba gnyis/ shrī a ma rend+ra pra ṇā ma/ dpal 'chi med dbang po la 'dud do/ /rab dkar ke la sha yi sa 'dzin ngos/ /rab mdzes bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis khyab pa ltar/ /rab tu gsal ba'i zhabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /rab dngas yid kyis 'dud do dge legs stsol/ /dbang sngon bzhu ba'i phung por mtshams sprin gyi/ /ral pa nye bar 'khrigs shing zla tshes kyi/ /mche ba gtsigs nas glog gi ljags 'dril ba/ /gnod byed tshar gcod kun tu bsrung bar mdzod/ /mchog dang thun mongs stsol mdzad bla ma dang / /'chi med dpal gter bstan bsrung nor lha'i tshogs/ /rab brtan yab sras yun ring 'tsho ba dang / /chab srid yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /spyan ras btsa' ba'i rten du dri zhim zhing / /ro bcud mchog ldan bṛ kṣa'i lo ma la/ /rgya skyegs me tog rtags kyi thig le can/ /sa ga'i dkar phyogs dga' ba'i tshes la phul/ /maṅga laṃ shū bhaṃ bardhantu// ༈ /seng ge rtse pa la// dge legs bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis khyab pa'i sku/ /mtshams sprin nyi ma gzhon nu gsal byas pa'i/ /rgyal dbang 'chi med dbang po'i byin rlabs kyis/

/rab brtan sku tshe yun du bsring gyur cig /srid zhi'i dgos 'dod ma lus nyer stsol ma/ /yid 'ong rin chen du ma'i do shal dang / /lha rdzas rnam par bkra ba'i na bza' can/ /nor rgyun dpal mos bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /dbang sngon sa 'dzin ngos la rta ljang can/ /'od zer bye bas brgyan pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /bgegs kun bsrung mdzad rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams/ /rab brtan 'di la rtag tu skyabs gyur cig /de ltar mtshon byed ne tra la/ /rdo rje'i sngags dang mdud pa yi/ /byin rlabs 'chi med gu li la/ /mu dra'i me tog 'di mchis so/ /shrī nā lend+ra shrardha pra ti dha shrī bha dra sya dīrgha yuksu ṇya wardhantu// ༈ /gzhis khar gnang ba// shrī rā da burdha ya na maḥ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khams gsum dbang bsgyur ngag gi dbang po mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbang rdo rje snyan cing grags pa'i rgyal mtshan lhun po'i rtse mor rab 'thon dpal yon bzang po/ /gang gi chab shog gser bzang shu gam brgyad dang dri med kha btags dkar po mu tra'i thig le ldan pa/ /sug par phebs pas yid dbang gser mngal bde ba'i khengs pa 'phrog cing dga' mgur spyod pa lags/ /slar yang shog bu'i ngos la snyun gsol mchid kyi glegs bum 'di ltar mchis kyi dges pa'i spyan zur g.yo zhing brtse ba'i thugs gyis nye bar dgongs te byams pa'i phyag sor rtse la rol rtsed bdag gir mdzod cig khyod kyi sku gsung thugs la nyes pa'i rdul bral khrims gnyis rgyal rnga phyogs bcur bsgrags pas byang phyogs kha ba'i ljongs kyi nor 'dzin dum bu srid mtha'i bar du bde bar bskyang du gsol/ /khyad par rnyigs ma'i dus kyi chos byed kun dang / nged kyi bla ma sa skya pa yi ring lugs bshad bsgrub bstan pa dri med gces 'dzin rnams 'tsho ba'i yo byad ci dgar spyod pa'i lugs dang khrims lugs bzang po sngon rabs 'dzangs pa'i rnam thar ji bzhin stsol mdzad/

da lan dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la phyag gnyis pa yi bstod pa phreng 'dzin zhes bya 'phags pa'i yul gyi dge slong gang / /chos kyi nyin byed 'bad pas brtsams pa de nyid bod kyi skad du kho bos legs par bsgyur zhing kha che'i yi ge la sogs sum 'di dag par bkod nas phul bas spyan gyi bdud rtsir mdzad 'tshal ces pa tha skar zla ba'i dmar cha mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i phyogs kyi tshes la sgo lnga dge ba'i sdings nas phul ba cung zad 'gyangs la thugs kyi mi khrel 'phral dang yun du bshis gyur cig /ka na kai ka shu gaṃ mu trasti shu bhontu// ༈ /gzhis kha rin spungs pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog dzñe yaṃ dha tu bi haṃ li lā bha ba tu ā byasatra ma no ya sya tsa/ gang gi thugs ni shes bya'i mkha' dbyings kun la rol zhing khyab gyur kyang / arbhū ta nṛ ma ya lo ki ka dza naṃ sa kā la pā laṃ kṛ taṃ/ rmad byung sgyu ma'i gar gyi 'jig rten skye dgu mtha' dag skyong mdzad pa/ dharmā ra dza ya shaṃ ma natp+ra bṛ ta tsa kraṃ bart+ti ā dī ra dzaṃ/ sngon gyi chos rgyal grags pa mtha' yas la sogs 'khor lo sgyur rgyal gyis/ su khaṃ hā ta ma haṃ ma hā pra ka ṣa shau bha karm+ma ni tyaṃ kṣ+mī shaṃ/ phan bde'i phrin las ches cher gsal mdzad nor 'dzin dbang po rtag tu rgyal/ /khyed sku dge mtshan dpag bsam ljon pa 'di/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i lo 'dab cher rgyas shing / /skal bzang don gnyis 'bras bu'i khur ldan khyod/ /mnga' 'bangs grib bsil brtan par bzhugs lags sam/ /khyod gsung snyan pa'i sprin gyi rnga sgra mchog /dus dang dus min 'tsham par legs 'doms shing / /gzhan sde dpa' skong rang srid dga' ba'i dbyangs/ /rtag tu bsgrin po'i tshul kyis 'chad la grangs/ /khyod thugs zag med bde chen 'od gsal ngang / /phyi nang gzhan gyis chos can ma 'dres shing / /kun khyab chos dbyings ji bzhin legs mkhyen nas/ /dus dang bstun pa'i rnam 'phrul cher mdzad dam/

/dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung zhing / /mthu stobs dbang phyug birwas byin rlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos tha mal tshul ston gang / /sa skya pa zhes rab grags rje btsun mchog /mgon de nye bar brten pa'i gzhal med khang / /lag ldan dbang po'i spyi bo ltar mtho zhing / /bkra shis dge mtshan du mas rnam spras pa/ /bhū mi paṇḍū ka zhes 'phags pa'i yul/ /snyan pa'i ba dan cher g.yo gang de nas/ /shākya'i dge slong mang du thos pa can/ /brda sprod gzhung sogs tha snyad kun sbyangs shing / /nges don snying po'i lam la blo phyogs pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /bas mtha' la brten bdag kyang legs byas kyi/ /dpal 'bar mi dbang khyod kyis bka' drin las/ /bde bar gnas shing mgon khyod bskal pa'i bar/ /sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas pa yi/ /smon lam 'debs la rtag tu brtson lags pas/ /legs par dgongs nas sngar bzhin spyan ras kyis/ /nye bar btsa' zhing kun tu bsrung bar mdzod/ /snyigs dus skye bo skal ngan gdug pa can/ /rang nyid mi bde'i gnas skabs dag las kyang / /gzhan gyi dpal la ches cher mi bzod pa'i/ /da dung phyogs 'dir spyan rgyang gzigs su gsol/ /da res rab brtan ming can g.yang pa dang / /nya chos yon tan phun tshogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /khyod kyis bka' bzhin kho bo'i bzhed don rnams/ /myur min sgrub ste khrims kyi gtsug lag khang / /bzhud nas zhal ras 'dzum zhing dges pa'i mdangs/ /bzhad pa'i nga ro phyi nang kun grags shing / /legs so brjod pa'i tshig gi gtang rag dang / /'phral lugs bde zhing skyid par bskyang du gsol/ /dge legs bye ba las bskrun khyed nyid kyi/ /bka' drin shin tu tshad med dran nas kyang / /slar yang gsol ja mtshon byed zhu ba dang / /sna tshogs gos dar la sogs 'bul ba yi/ /dngos po cung zad khyer nas kho bo dang / /lhan cig gnas pa'i nye gnas 'di bzhud pas/

/chung ngur gyur la thugs kyi mi bas shing / /brtse ba'i phyag gis myur bar bzhes su gsol/ /yon tan dpag med 'dus pa zhes bya'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs rgyal dbang mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i byin rlabs mtha' yas dang / /dpal gyi ri bo'i ngos la ku ru kulle'i phug nas rje btsun rig byed lha mo kā ka tsa le tshogs kyi bdag po sogs/ /khams gsum 'gugs mdzad dbang gi lha dang ye shes rdo rjes spyan ldan ma hā kā la lcam dral zhing skyong gdong bzhi las mgon mchog /yakṣa pu tra rnams kyi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sa skyong rgyal po sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /kun 'dus zhes bya me mo phag gi na chung ni/ /gro zhun zla ba'i na tshod rab tu dar la bab/ /seng ge'i khyim gyi skye mched yongs su gang ba la/ /dga' ba'i tshes kyi rin chen do shal gyis rgyan tshe/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa nas/ /nye bar phul ba'i yi kha tam/ /phan bde'i lo tog cher rgyas zhing / /'phral dang yun du bde legs shog/ ༈ /gzhis kha rin spungs su gnang ba// swasti dza yantu/ dge legs rgyal bar gyur/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i gar mkhan nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od kyi dra bas phyogs kun gsal mdzad pa/ /dpal be'u la sogs mtshan dang dpe byad du ma'i ri bong gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan pa'i phrin las bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar dang / /dpal 'bar rgyal ba'i myu gu thos sgrogs zhi ba'i lam nas sgyu skar phreng ba'i do shal mgrin par rab tu 'phyang ba can/ /dpal ldan 'bum phrag lnga pa'i brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i mgon gyis dge legs stsol/ /gangs can nor 'dzin gyi thig ler phan bder skyong ba'i shrī nus ldan dbang po khu dbon yab sras blon 'bangs dang bcas pa sku'i 'tsho ba mdangs gsal ba la cung bro 'tshal ba'i rnam par gyur 'dug nang /

/bsod nams bye ba'i dpal yon zad mi shes pa'i chu gter chen po las/ /rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs zla ba'i lag ma phyogs brgyar drangs te/ /mi bsrun pa'i bdud sde mtha' dag dpa' skong ba'i rdo rje'i khor yug gi khongs su dge legs kyi 'dzin mar phan bde'i skye mched kyi lo tog lhag par rgyas shing sku'i gzi byin 'chi med dbang po'i lang tsho la 'gran pa lta bur gyur pa'i snyan grags gdugs dkar gyi thig le phyogs kyi gzhon nu ma'i 'gul pa las nye bar thos pas yid rab tu spro ba dang / ut+sa ba dang / ut+sā ha dang / a ti ra ma dang / pra sā ha rnams ches cher thob pa lags/ /slar yang sku'i 'tsho ba brtan pa'i thabs gtso bor bzhes ngos/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde 'jags kyi phrin las dang / sku'i rim gro rnam par dkar ba kho na bsgrub pa la gcig tu 'grus shing / sde dgon gnas gzhi 'di pa'ang sngar bzhin thugs rtsa la sbyar ba'i gnang bkod phul du byung ba'i ngo mtshar gyi/ zhal ltas khyab pa mdzad mtshal/ 'dir yang sku'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa dang / mnga' 'bangs rgyas pa'i smon lam bsrung 'khor g.yel med bgyid cing mchis/ da lan skabs kyi gsol ja brten bcas brda mtshon tsam 'bul bar 'khor du gnas pa'i su sa khi dpon g.yog rnams bzhud lags pa/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis brtse ba'i spyan ras kyi nye bar rtsal ba 'tshal/ rgya chen chos kun gzigs pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rnam 'dren bslu ba med pa'i skyabs chen gsum/ /mthu stobs thogs med rdo rje'i chos skyong can/ /mi dbang 'khor bcas rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /mchu can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis la shrī bhū mi paṇḍu ka sardharmā sa nā tashu bhaṃ li khi taṃ/ dpal sa skya dam ba'i chos grwa nas dge bar bris// ༈ /gzhis kha rin spungs su gnang ba/ na mo pa ri mi tā a yurdzñā na bha ga wa te/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rab mang bskal pa du mar tshogs gnyis legs byas ches cher goms pa'i phul byung gzugs kyi sku yi dpal 'bar ba/ /rab brtan padma rā ga'i rdul brtsegs ngos la rta ljangs can gyi 'od zer bye bas nye bar brgyan pa'i snang brnyan mchog /rab tu gsal zhing mdzes pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad phreng ba'i do shal dang ldan rgyal dbang 'chi med mgon po gang de'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rab dkar bsod nams brgya phrag dbang 'byor chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje grags pa yun ring bskal par zhabs brtan gnas gyur cig /byu ru'i sdong po li khri'i mdangs ldan pa/ /mdzes shing chags pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad phyag gi yal 'dab can/ /sa gsum dbang bsgyur rig byed lha mo yi/ /mi dbang skye dgu'i dbang phyug nyid du mdzod/ /'jigs pa'i nyams ldan dbang sngon lhun po ni/ /mtshams sprin ral pa nyi zla'i sdang mig can/ /mche ba'i rgyu skar srid gsum za byed pa/ /rdo rje'i bsrungs mas mi dbang skyong bar mdzod/ /ces pa bkra shis dang bde legs kyi gā tha sngon du btang nas mi'i dbang po khu dbon blon 'bangs dang bcas pa la snyun gsol ba ni/ legs byas ral pa 'thug pos gnya' khebs can/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i spyan mig rnam par g.yo/ /gzhan sde'i dregs pa zil gnon mche sder gyis/ /phas rgol wa skyes mthar mdzad gang de nyid/ /dpa' 'dzangs blon po'i ri dwags nags na brtson/ /rang sde nags kyi sman ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /khrims gnyis rgyal rnga'i gad rgyangs cher bsgrags pas/ /nags kyi dpal mo'i dga' ston mdzad lags drangs/ /skyo shas bas mtha'i dge slong skad gnyis pa/ /snyoms las mig gi chu skyes rab zum kyang / /nges don rtogs pa'i blo gros kha phye nas/ /gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i dogs pa mi dman tsam/ /de ltar snyun gsol zhing rang nyid kyi ngang tshul cung zad brjod nas/ slar yang mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/

'di phyi'i bde legs 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /ches cher rgyas pa'i thabs la 'grus pa dang / /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams 'chad nyan gyis/ /phrin las phyogs kun rab tu rgyas par mdzod/ /gangs can sa yi thig le'i skye dgu rnams/ /'khrul long med cing bde bar skyong ba dang / /mnga' 'bangs chab srid kun tu rgyas pa yi/ /thabs mkhas mi dbang khyod kyis bgyi bar 'os/ /rje btsun dam pa rnams kyi bsten pa'i gnas/ /sa skya'i dgon gnas 'dir yang ring pa'i dus/ /ches cher lon pas ming tsam lhag mar lus/ /da dung nus ldan khyod kyis legs par skyongs/ /spong bar gnas pa bdag kyang dam pa'i chos/ /nyams su len dang gzhan la 'chad pa sogs/ /tshul dang mthun pa'i blang dor bgyid bsam pas/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis sngags bzhin bskyang du gsol/ /'gro kun dbang sdud rig byed lha mo dang / /khams gsum 'gugs mdzad kra ki rā dza dang / /dpal 'byor mchog stsol ga ṇa pa ti yis/ /dgos 'dod char 'bebs gsum gyi bkra shis shog /lo gsar pa shar ba'i bkra shis 'bul brten tho chung du gsal ba ltar lags/ cha 'phras pa la thugs kyi mi bas pa zhu/ sa mo glang gi lo mī na'i khyim du rta ljang rnams par brtson pa'i dkar phyogs da sha thi li khyā tra// ༈ /gzhir khar gnang ba 'di'i 'go'i tshigs bcad ma tshang / de ltar bkra shis dang bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pas rgyas par mnga' gsol nas/ /deng gi dus la spyod pa'i rgyal byin 'khor dang bcas pa sku'i gzi byin legs bris dbang po'i dpal la 'gran cing / gsung gi phrin las sngon gyi sprul pa'i chos rgyal rim par byon pa rnams las ches lhag pa'i rnam 'phrul dang ldan pas rang srid rnam par rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas la gzhar yang mi lhod par bzhugs lags sam/ yu bu cag kyang lus sems sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ye 'byams chen po'i ngang las/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog bsgom la rtag 'grus kyi gnas lags/

da lan gnas skabs kyi gsol ja mtshon byed zhu bar/ bar tsho ba u gra ba badzra bzhud yod lags pa/ alpa sto ka la thugs kyi mi khrel ngos/ sku'i 'tsho ba yun ring du brtan pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa bzang po nam yang mi nyams pa dang / /bas mtha' la rten pa'i chos byed kyi tha snyad 'di pa'ang / brtse bas bskyang du gsol/ kumbha'i khyim mchu can dkar po'i phyogs tshes brgyad la dpal sa skya dang nye ba'i ri khrod byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong nas dge bar phul/ /maṅga laṃ shu bhontu// ༈ /sde pa zil gnon pa la bka' shog /na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gsal gur gum gzhon nu'i sku/ /rab 'bar sngo sangs ral gri dang / /rab zab rgyal yum glegs bam bsnams/ /rab rgyas snying gi pad mar bzhugs/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i utpal spyan/ /mi dbang zil gnon rdo rje gangs/ /gser gyi khri la rab 'khod nas/ /yangs pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur zhing / /bde dang dge bar spyod lags sam/ /chos kyi mdun sar gnas pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kho bo yang / /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor rab bde zhing / /nges don mchog gi rnal 'byor dang / /lam 'bras rgyud 'grel la sogs pa'i/ /'chad nyan chos kyi bya ba la/ /rtag tu 'grus shing dge bar gnas/ /slar yang phyogs 'dir bstan pa dang / /chos mthun gnas pa kho bo cag /rim gnyis rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ /nyer 'tshe med pa'i zos bde ba'i/ /thabs mkhas khyed kyi bgyis pa lags/ /skabs kyi gsol ja mtshon byed tsam/ /zhu bar mi sna brdzangs pa 'di/ /ched du gtad nas bzhud lags pa/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol// ༈ /sde pa zil gnon pa la// shrī rastu/ lhar bcas skye dgu mtha' dag zil gnon cing / /phas rgol lha min dpung 'joms rdo rje can/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i spyan stong rab gsal ba'i/ /sa la 'phos pa'i lha dbang gang de'i drung /

/shākya'i dge sbyong mang du thos pa can/ /nges don gdams pa lhur len spong ba pa/ /sa skya'i lo tsā ā nanda zhes pas/ /rtse gcig 'dun pa'i yid kyis 'di skad zhu/ /khyed sku nyes pa'i chu 'dzin dang bral zhing / /gsung dbyangs sprin gyi rnga chen mi 'gag par/ /zab gsal thugs kyi glog phreng rnam bkra ba/ /phrin las gzi byin kun nas rgyas so zhes/ /thos pa'i mod la ba spu'i phreng ba yang / /kun nas g.yos shing yid dbang chu skyes ni/ /ze'u 'bru rnam par rgod pa'i dpal du gyur/ /slar yang mi dbang khu dbon blon po dang / /'bangs su bcas pa chab srid dbyar mtsho ltar/ /ches cher rgyas pa'i bkra shis dga' ston ni/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi mig gi gso 'gyur nas/ /bas mthar gnas pa kho bo cag la sogs/ /zos bde skyid pa'i bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ /da res ma hā kā la'i bstod pa dang / /dzo ki'i skad sogs mkho dgu'i sna grangs la/ /ba 'o 'byar ba 'bul gyi dges par mdzod/ /tha skar zla ba'i dmar cha tshes bcu la/ /dge sdings dge ba'i gnas nas dge bar phul/ /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ// ༈ /g.yung pa la gnang ba/ shrī swasti/ legs byas dpal gyi 'od rab 'bar/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i mchog /mi dbang phrin las kha lo pa/ /bkra shis ming can g.yung pa la/ /sa skya'i dge slong spong ba pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa āndas/ /bsnyun 'dri'i mchid kyi le kha 'di/ /bde legs brjod pa 'di ltar lags/ /snga rol yi ge phrug zung gi/ /brten bcas mi dbang lung bzang po'i/ /sgo gsal nye bar son pa las/ /lha dbang bde ba'i dpal la 'gran/ /khyod nyid lus kyi 'tsho ba ni/ /bskal pa'i bar du brtas pa dang / /khrims kyi rgyal mtshan nyer bzung nas/ /gtsang dbus rgyal khams bde bar skyong / /'dir yang nus ldan dbang po ni/ /blon 'bangs bcas pa rgyal thabs che/ /bsrung 'khor smon lam phrin bcol sogs/ /rtag tu gus pa'i khur ldan gyi/

/dngos la'ang sngar bzhin dges pa dang / /shin tu bde bar bskyang du gsol/ /tha skar zla ba'i nyer lnga la/ /sgo lnga bde ba'i sdings nas dge/ /su wārṇe ka shu gam mu drapti// ༈ /g.yung pa la gnang ba// na maḥshrī bāg de bā sa raswa tyai/ mañdzu ra ṇa mai ba ma ti ma lā ta/ blo gros dri med 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mtshungs/ /bista ra lakṣ+maṃ sa ma bai shra mā ṇa/ rab rgyas dpal 'byor rnam thos sras lta bu/ /a sra sa mā bī ra na rā ya ne ba/ 'gran zla med pa'i dpa' rtsal sred med bu/ dwi shī la mau khā ba ha brti pa ram/ khrims gnyis kha lo bsgyur ba'i ded dpon mchog /bsod nams bye ba'i dpal las 'khrungs/ /mi dbang sa skyong chen po yi/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi shing rta la/ /nye bar gshibs nas dgra sde kun/ /phye mar 'thag mdzad khyod nyid kyang / /rang srid rnam par rgyas pa yi/ /byed pa'i bsgyur rtsal thabs la mkhas/ /dga' bde'i dpal la spyod gyur ram/ /phyogs 'dir g.yang pa skya btsun gyi/ /dpon blon bka' bzhin zhabs bcug nas/ /kho bo cag kyang zos bde bar/ /kha ton dge sbyor la brtson gnas/ /de ltar gyur pa'ang mi dbang mchog /blon po khyod kyi gzi brjid dang / /thabs mkhas rdzu 'phrul las yin par/ /nges nas slar yang dga' ba skyes/ /da dung byang gi ser bu dang / /gtad med mi ngan byed pa yi/ /snang tshul ci 'gyur mi shes pas/ /'jug sdom legs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /da lan grangs dbang 'di nyid kyang / /legs pa'i gtang rag skyes 'bul bar/ /ched du gtad nas brdzangs pa lags/ /chung du chen por bzhes su gsol/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog chos bsrungs kyis/ /byin rlabs nus mthus mi dbang mchog de dang / /bkra shis khyod nyid tshe dpal rgyas gyur cig /sa phag hor zla bdun pa yi/ /dmar cha rgyal ba'i tshes dag la/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa nas/

/'phral du myur bar bris pa dge/ ༈ /sde pa ngag dbang pa la gzhis khar phul ba'i zhu shog mu tig gi chun po 'di/ /snar thang sde pa'i rtsom grogs zhus nas mdzad pa lags/ oṃ swasti/ bkra shis dge legs du ma'i rin chen ni/ /brtan par spungs pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i khrir/ /lugs gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo sgyur ba can/ /ngag dbang lha yi rje bo'i zhabs drung du/ /dbang phyug nor 'dzin thig ler gnas pa yi/ /bka' 'bangs tha chung gang de'i 'di skad zhu/ /bsod nams bye ba'i dpal 'bar khyed kyi sku/ /chab srid dbyar mtsho'i dga' ston rab rgyas shing / /khor yug kun du snyan pa'i ba dan mchog /ches cher bsgrengs bas phyogs kyi phas rgol rnams/ /'dar zhing zhum pa bskyed byed bsam yas pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul gar gyis bde bar skyong / /bdag kyang 'dzum zhal dkyil 'khor blta ba dang / /lo gsar bkra shis 'bul bar slebs spro yang / /nye dus 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i bro nad kyi/ /cung zad gtses las byung ba'i brtan pa bcom/ /de lta mod kyi mi dbang khu dbon dang / /blon 'bangs sku tshe mi 'gyur zhabs brtan zhing / /rang srid phyogs mtha' kun nas rgyas pa dang / /rab dges thugs kyi rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad/ /bkra shis lo gsar 'bul ba'i tha snyad tsam/ /bgyid par ched du gtad nas brdzangs lags pa/ /chung ngur gyur la thugs kyi mi khrel zhing / /phyogs 'dir brtse ba'i thugs kyis bskyang du gsol/ /rgyal zla dkar phyogs gang ba'i tshes bzang la/ /'od dkar can dang rgyal gyi rol rtsed dus/ /chu srin khyim du padma'i gnyen zhugs nas/ /bcu phrag gnyis lon 'od zer rgyas tshe phul// ༈ /tshong 'dus pa la gnang pa'i bka' shog/ /swasti dza yantu/ bkra shis rgyal par gyur cig dpal ldan padma rā ga'i 'od zer 'phro/ /'chi med bdud rtsi yongs gang bum bzang bsnams/ /rdo rje dkyil dkrung mchog tu brtan bzhugs pa'i/

/rgyal dbang 'chi med mgon pos bde legs mdzod/ /khrims gnyis kha lo sgyur ba'i nus ldan khyod/ /rnam smin 'tsho ba brtan zhing lam bzang la/ /gcig tu dad pa'i skabs 'gar bsgom pa dang / /'dir snang 'jig rten bya ba'i blang dor kun/ /legs par shes nas rang srid rgyas pa dang / /gzhan phyogs zil gnon dpa' zhing rtul phod pas/ /bde bar 'tsho zhing rang khyim kho na na/ /gnas ces kha skad 'phar ba'i gtam las thos/ /ngag gi dbang pos byin rlabs lha yi rigs/ /shākya'i dge slong sa skya pa de yang / /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor nyer 'tshes rab dben zhing / /rim gnyis thun bsgom lam mchog chos 'chad dang / /rtsom pa'i bya bas dus kun dge bar rgyu/ /gtsang phyogs sa yi thig le khol bur nam bgrod snyam/ /yid la 'jags shing 'dun par yod na'ang / /yul dus bskal bas re zhig the tshom 'gyur/ /khyod nyid lus zung yun ring 'tsho ba dang / /dge ba'i spyod pas dbus gtsang bde ba'i thabs/ /khyad par singha rā dza'i mtshan jus rkang / /legs nyes khyod la re bas phugs kyang don/ /'chug med gsang ba'i gter du dam par sbos/ /kho bo'i phyogs gtogs rnams la'ang sngar bzhin du/ /skyon med ston cing gang phan phrin las mdzod/ /nged kyi nye 'khor dge slong 'di nyid kyang / /chos spyod sgrub phyir phyogs der rab bzhud pas/ /hā hā gad rgyangs bsu zhing dges dgur 'dzum/ /sha tsha'i gros slob mthun pa'i gtam gyis shig /rigs kyi bu kye ces pa'i gtam snyan pa/ /legs par thos pas spro ba'i mtshon byed du/ /bkra shis kha thags dar yug ja sdum la/ /mu dra'i tshom bus rab brgyan 'di thal lo/ /sa ga'i yar ngo rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes/ /chos grags nā lend+ra nas bris pa dge/ /sha ta sampāt+sa ro pa dzī bantu/ gcig zhus// ༈ /gnas gsar ba la gnang ba'i bka' shog/ ma hā mu tra dharam dha tu bodha yantu/ chos gyi dbyings phyag rgya chen po rtogs par gyur cig

lam bslu med ston mdzad sa skya'i rje/ /spyir khams gsum yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dad gus can gyi gnas sar ba/ /nam mkha'i ming can la dngos grub stsol/ /'od gsal 'chi med kyi rigs skyes pa'i/ /shākya'i bstan 'dzin sa skya pa/ /a nanda yis 'di skad lo/ /khyod lnga phung bro nad kyi ma gtses shing / /lam rim gnyis sgom pa'i rnam g.yeng la/ /tshe 'dir snang gi bde skyid rgyas pa'i ngang / /dpal singha rā dza'i cha zhabs kyis/ /rang khyim ci bder sgyu zhes pa'i/ /kha skad phyogs bcu'i ngag las thos/ /gtam de yang snyan no nged cag kyang / /sgyu lus kyi bskyod pa rab yang zhing / /zab gsal gyi rnal 'byor las ma g.yos par/ /chos legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /slob ma kun dga' spro skyed cing gda'/ /da dus ring min par sa phyogs der/ /myur du 'phrad pa'i rtse 'jo dang / /lugs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag smra 'dod kyang / /yul dus kyi skal bas re zhig la/ /lo kha yar gyi bar du 'gyangs pa 'dra/ /gang ltar kyang khyod rang pha bu rnams/ /stod smad sde srid dgongs pa rab mthun cing / /bgo skal gyi bya ba la blang dor dang / /khams rgyun ring bzang ba'i 'tsho rtsis gyis/ /kho bos kyang legs pa'i smon lam dang / /srung 'khor bstan bsrung la phrin bcol bgyid/ /da lan dge slong nye gnas 'khor bcas rnams/ /gtsang stod kyi dgon par mang bkol dang / /sa skya'i nye skor kun blta rtog la/ /legs par brdzangs pa phyogs der yang / /bslab don la re gron med pa dang / /'phral phugs kyi 'dun ma'i rkang skya mdzod/ /le kha'i rten du sngags mdud dang / /'chi med kyi gu li ja thum la/ /ba ho yis brgyan pa 'di ltar ro/ /sa skyong sa ga'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes dag la/ /rgyun gyi dbang po'i chos khri nas/ /legs par bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /su kha sharma bha wantu// ༈ /gnas pa 'byor chen la bka' shog gnang ba/

shrī dza yantu/ legs bshad byas ba'i margad 'khyil pa'i dbus su rnam par rgyal ba'i dal 'byor lus bzang chu ba rab brtan zhing / /legs par gsal ba'i lugs gnyis rnam dpyod gser gyi chu skyes 'dab stong 'od gsal gnyis skyes ze'u 'bru rab gsal bas/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dog pa rnam par skyed byed ma dhu ro ldan blo gsal rkang drug dga' ston rab ster gang / /legs par spyod tshul ya rabs 'dzangs pa'i mi chen rjes 'brangs rnam par dngas pa'i nus ldan dbang po rab tu rgyal/ /chab shog ngang pa'i ded dpon ni/ /yid 'ong tshig gi spu sdug can/ /rnam bkra snyan ngags mdangs gsal zhing / /gus pa'i ca co ci yang sgrog /ro bcud ra sā ya na yi/ /skyes la ba 'o ldan pa yang / /pho nya dpung pa'i yal 'dab las/ /mod la gnyis skyes 'dzum phreng dang / /spro ba'i dpal gyis rnam 'gyur byas/ /rdo rje'i lha tshogs ro 'dzin dbang / /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i dga' ston 'gyur/ /nyid rang lus kyi 'tsho ba brtas/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi rgyal rnga yang / /khor yug rab tu cher grags shing / /yid can 'tsho ba'i dge legs thob/ /da dung tshul de ma nyams par/ /brtan zhing bde pa'i lugs bzang dag /dbyar mtsho lta bur rab rgyas nas/ /phyogs 'dir rnam dkar blo can dang / /sdebs legs yi ge'i phreng ba yangs/ /dus su mtshams par bsnyun 'dri'i tshul/ /'byon dang bzhud pa'i dpal mchog gang / /rtag 'grus tshig gi gtang rag bgyid/ /bla ma mchod chog rgyas bsdus gnyis/ /nged kyi legs par brtsams pa 'di/ /rgyun du kha ton dge sbyor gyis/ /gtso bor bgyis pa ches mang yod/ /da lan mchod chog rgyas pa'i tshig /legs par bris nas bsrings yod pas/ /nyid kyang 'bad stsol nyams len dang / /dad ldan gzhan la'ang legs par spel/ /rang gnas bsod nams ye shes kyis/ /tshogs rab rgyas pa'i dpal yon dang / /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i myu gu yang /

/ches cher bskyed pa'i bde legs 'byung / /rdo rje'i bsrungs ma rnams la yang / /rdo rje'i dam tshig rab bskul zhing / /rdo rje'i ra bar legs bsrung pa'i/ /rdo rje lta bu'i smon lam 'debs/ /ri mo'i rten du 'chi med kyi/ /ril bu gzugs sogs grangs ldan dang / /ne tra sngags kyi mdud pa la/ /rtags kyi thig le bkod pa yod/ /dga' ba zhes bya chu 'brug lo'i/ /chu stod dmar cha bkra shis kyi/ /tshes la mkhas pa'i chos grags mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i khri nas bris/ /gcig zhus// ༈ /gnas pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog/ /lakṣ+mī bstī ra bho wantu/ snang grags kyi 'khor lo la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rje btsun gyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang skyabs chen gsum/ /dpal tshangs pa'i yul sar brtan bzhugs la/ /dus 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phral mthong na nyams dga'i 'dzum ril can/ /khrims gnyis kyi rgyal rnga legs 'dzin pa/ /dpon che btsun gyi thugs zin nang blon mchog /dus 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal sa skya lo tsā ā nandas/ /rgyang ring po nas skyo ba'i gtam 'di springs/ /khyed dpon blon sku yi nyer 'tsho brtan/ /rang srid kyi mnga' 'bangs ches cher rgyas/ /phyogs kun nas dga' zhing skyid pa'i gtam/ /thag rings kyi gnas skor ba'i kha nas thos/ /de snyan cing yid la 'bab pa byung / /rang gang dran gyi spyod pas rgyal khams 'grims/ /phugs bla ma dkon mchog la blo gtad pa'i/ /rigs sngags 'chang kho bo 'khor bcas kyang / /lus na tsha med cing zo mdog bzang / /kha ton chos spyod kyi rims pa rnams/ /ma chag cing gzhan la chos 'chad dang / /bsam sgom brtson pa la sogs pa'i/ /rnam g.yeng gi ngang nas bde bar bdog /da dus nye bar sa der myur sleb na/ /'dzum mu le ba'i zhabs skya bgyid bsam kyang / /sa yul gyi skal bas skyid pa skyur/ /shin tu skyo zhing tur tur dran/

/dran kyang mthong ba'i yul min pas/ /mjal bar spro yang re zhig bar/ /yid gnyis kyi ngang du zhugs pa 'dra/ /gang na'ang rgyal thabs la mkhas pa dang / /'phral phugs kyi 'dun ma tshod zin cing / /nged phyogs gtogs sngar bzhin skyong bar rigs/ /'dir srung 'khor smon lam bstan bsrungs kyis/ /mchod gtor dus phrin las 'chol ba sogs/ /sku rim kyi 'bad stsol yang dag byed/ /le kha lta ba'i rten du si chos kyis/ /yul nas yongs pa'i ja bzang thum bu la/ /shel kyi mu dra bkod pa 'di ltar ro/ /shing dbyangs can dkar phyogs kyis/ /rgyal ba gnyis la nā lend+ra nas bris// ༈ /mus nas gcod pa nam mkha' la gnang ba/ /na mo mañdzu badzra ya/ dge bsnyen ngag gi dbang po'i le kha dang / /ja gos phyag rgya ldan pa'i pho nya dag /bsam gtan khang bu'i mdun sar sleb pa na/ /yid kyi ku mud zla ba'i dpal la spyod/ /phyogs 'dir grang ba'i reg bya rtsub pas na/ /gsa' dang lce spyang 'phar ba lug sogs kyi/ /lpags pa'i chos gos gon pa'i dge slong dag /bas mthar rgyu zhing bsam gtan spyod pas na/ /snal gos dro mang de dag do zla min/ /kha ba'i mdung dang rlung gi mda' 'phen cing / /ba mo'i reg pa'i dgung tog bsnun pa'i tshe/ /la ba'i go cha btsan yang phye mar brlog /slar yang khyod kyis bgyi bar 'os pa ni/ /zhim pa'i ja chang snyan pa'i gtam smros la/ /bla ma'i sku brnyan 'bri la rtag 'grus pa'i/ /lha yi rig byed mkhan de cung zad bskul/ /dkar phyogs rim 'gro dag la brtson par byed/ /rmi lam tshab tshub sems kyi nying 'khrul yin/ /'on kyang gdon gyi gnod pa zhi ba'i phyir/ /mgon po'i thugs dam bskang zhing gnod byed la/ /lan chags gtor ma gang 'grub gtong du chug /da lan 'chi ba med pa'i gū li mchog /phyogs dang zla ba'i grangs la mu dra yi/ /nye bar mtshon pa khyod la skyes su byin/ /smin drug dkar phyogs nya ba'i tshes la dge/

/maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rin chen rtse pa'i gnyer pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog /rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa la springs pa/ /bris sku rnams la rab gnas legs par byas phyir bskur ba yin cing / /nged kyi thob yig de da lta 'dir ma phyi la g.yar gtang yod pas der bskur ba ma byung / kyai rdo rje'i dbang thob nas/ mngon rtogs sgom pas los chog de 'dra 'dri ga la dgos/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu la/ sa lugs kyi 'grel par ming btags pa ni ma mthong / don la rje btsun gyi tho yig dang / bla ma dam pa'i mngon rtogs che chung gnyi ka 'grel pa yin mod/ /dkyil chog rdo rje las rim dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon padmas mdzad pa yong gi 'dug dgos pa gsum gyi lus dbul lo/ /zhes pa/ bla ma la lus phul bas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i dgos pa/ sangs rgyas la lus phul bas mthar thug 'bras bu de 'dra ba cig thob pa'i dgos pa/ sems can la lus phul bas ma 'ong pa na gdul byar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa gsum yin/ gshin rje dmar nag ces pa ni/ snying ma la grags pa'i kha thun/ gdong drug zil gnon/ ma ru rtse rnams dang / gsal ma'i dmar nag 'jigs gsum kyang yin pa 'dra/ gying ka ra ces pa ni/ 'og gi sman mchod kyi skabs na gying chen bco brgyad gying phran 'bum sde la/ ces pa dang don gcig btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po sogs 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams yin la/ 'di dag ngos 'dzin rnying ma'i yig cha rgya che ba rnams su gsal/ lha bskyed dus/ srog gi sgor shar ba dang / ces pa'i don lus sems btags pa'i tshogs pa lhan cig tu 'dus pa la srog chags zhes pa'i tha snyad 'jig rten la 'dug pa ltar/ lha bskyed pa'i gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de yi dam gyi skur gyur nas bsgom pa'i don yin/ snying kha'i dkyil du bsgom par bya/ zhes pa ni/ rag gi snying khar sngar gyi hūm̐ de nyid kyi rgyun nam/

ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom pa'i don yin/ bdag nyid ma dang / shwa na ma la bstod pa'i skabs su re re las med cing / sa bdag ma'i skabs su so sor bstod pa 'di rnams/ slob dpon padmas phrin las rnying pa rnams su 'di bzhin mdzad pa/ de ka'i rgyun yin pa 'dra/ phra thabs rnams bskyed pa'i skabs su/ zhon pa med kyang bstod bskul gyi dus su phra thabs re re kyang rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa zhon pa dang bcas pas dgra bgegs bsgrol ba la sogs pa'i las mdzad pa la bsam nas de ltar byas pa yin/ lhag ma'i skabs su dkar por 'phros pas dmar por sogs pa'i don/ gtso bo yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa las pho nya'i tshogs 'di lta bu sprul ces pa'i don yin/ rigs 'dzin bskul ba'i dus/ rgya bod kyi sngags 'chang nus pa che ba rnams smos pa ma gtogs/ dbang gi brgyud pa 'dren pa ma yin/ gtor bzlog gi dus su rang gtor ma dang gnyis su med par lhar bskyed nas zor brdeg khar rang gtor ma las logs su bye ba'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bsgom zhing / gtor ma'i dam ye so sor bsgom tshul gtor bzlog gi zin bris na gsal/ ha cang zhib grags na rang nyal dus gtor ma yang smyol dgos sam/ hā hā/ gzhal yas khang mi sgom par 'khor rkyang pa sgom dus phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtser sgo ma rnams bsgom dgos pa yin/ thog bsrung dgos zer ba/ sngags dang lha sku mang du bri dgos pas/ lha bris pa dang yig mkhan sogs stabs 'grig pa byung na/ 'dir gang 'grub lta ba yod// ༈ /'bul bsdud pa la gnang ba khams gyi lam yig chen mo// shrī ra nā di na tha bā gi shwa rā ya/ tshogs gnyis chu gter dbus na legs thon tshad med rin chen sna bzhi'i bang rim can/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems gnyis bdud rtsi'i 'od dang rta ljang dkyil 'khor gyis/ /phrin las 'od zer rnam gnyis rdo rje'i khor yug rtse las cher gsal rab 'phro ba'i/

/sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs brgyud par bcas la rtag tu 'dud do dge legs stsol/ /phun tshogs dngos grub rgya chen mchog ster yi ge bzhi ldan lhag pa'i lha rnams dang / /thugs rje'i 'od dkar phyag na padma 'jam pa'i rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po sogs/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu ye shes spyan ldan rdo rje'i chos skyong ma hā kā la dang / /tsa turmu kha yakṣa pu tra lcam sring nyi zla'i tshogs kyi nye bar bsrungs/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i yid 'gugs dpal ldan rig byed lha mo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / /ga ṇe shwa ra rnam thos sras dang nor rgyun lha mo dzambha la la sogs/ /dbang dang rgyas pa'i lha yis tshe dang nor gyi dngos grub kun stsol 'jig rten gyis/ /dregs pa sde brgyad la sogs lha 'dre mi gsum yid can mtha' dag stong grogs mdzod/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas pa'i bka'/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i lung / /rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi gtso mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi le kha/ /dpal sa skya lo tsa ba shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad la rnam par rgyal ba'i yi ge/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas brtsams te/ gtsang / dbus/ khams gsum gyi sa cha la yod pa'i chos sde so so'i bla ma slob dpon/ yul khams tha dad kyi sde pa/ dpon skya che chung / rdzong gzhis kyi gnyer pa/ dmag jag ser yig gi 'grim 'grul byed mi/ gru/ zam/ shan gyi gnyer pa/ lam 'phrang bsrung mi/ gzhan yang sne mor bskos pa'i las byed/ mdor na lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad la springs pa/ sngon gyi dus su/ nged kyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po khu dbon gyi rgya nag dang bod kyi skye dgu mtha' dag smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing /

chos dang 'jig rten gyi bka' drin chen po bla na med pa bskyangs pa/ drag zhan thams cad kyi blo la gsal ba de yin/ khyad par nged kyis kyang / dbus gtsang gi sa char bsdad nas/ rgya bod khams gsum gyi gdul bya 'os su gyur pa rnams la chos dang 'jig rten gyi skyong lugs tshul dang mthun par byas yod pas/ gong du smos pa'i bla ma sa skya pa yab sras kyi dus mchod dang / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / mkhyen rab dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs mnga' ba'i/ chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u lo/ hor zla brgyad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can tshes bcu'i tho rangs/ rdo rje thegs pa'i rgyud sde zab mo nas bshad pa'i 'da' kha ma zab mo la mnyam par gzhag ste/ bde ba can du gshegs pa la the tshom mi za ba'i yid ches rang la gdengs thob pa byung pas de nyid kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ lo dang zla ba'i dus kyi mchod pa la/ dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po'i bsnyen bskur/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin/ chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams dang / 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin pa sogs/ dug gsum med pa'i dge rtsa ci 'grub bgyid bsam pa/ da lan don sngar brjod pa de rnams kyi phyir/ bla ma sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho dpon slob 'di rnams khams phyogs kyi grags pa yon bdag so so'i/ dad 'bul/ ci yong len par brdzangs pa yin pas/ 'di'i thad du/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa dang / nged la chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'am/ shin tu dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams gyis/ rang rang gi 'byor tshod la dpags pa'i 'bul ba'i dngos po blo nus gang che sgrub pa dang / kha 'dzin bshags 'debs/ grogs dan mthun rkyen du gang 'gro gyis/ de ltar byas pa thams cad kyang / sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs/

phyi rten dang nang rten gtsug lag khang zhig gso/ /tshul dus mchod sogs rnam dkar gyi dge ba kho na ma gtogs/ log pa'i 'tsho bar skad cig kyang mi 'gro ba yin/ gong 'khod las 'gal ba'i 'di pa dpon slob la dbang che/ shes mongs/ dgra/ jag rkun gsum mi 'os ba'i lam la bgor skyil sogs/ mdor na gnod 'tshe log sgrub sus byas de/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang / lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma lcam dral/ dpal mgon po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dam can gnod sbyin pho mo/ bka' stod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral/ phur bsrungs dam can bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bskor bdag rgyal po pe dkar 'khor bcas dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyi gnod byed thams cad rten zhing skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i rten phur phyung / snying khrag thang la pho/ 'bar ba'i hom khung du bcug nas/ rdo rje'i thun gyi brabs te/ rnam smin gyi sha rus dum bur btang la/ yid kyi shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyol cig ji ltar bka' bsgos pa bzhin du chos skyong bsrung ma las byed kyi pho nya dang bcas pas gtong grogs mgon skyabs phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod/ dpag yas don gnyis mthar phrin rnam 'dren gtso/ /rgya chen lung dang mngon rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /rigs grol yon tan ldan pa 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gnas bslu med bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag 'gyur ba med/ /chos can rten cing 'brel 'byung mi bslu bas/ /chos bsrungs dbang bskur nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /don 'di 'bad med 'grub pa'i phrin las dang /

/bdag cag dpon slob gzhi byes 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe la bar chad med cing bsam pa'i don/ /chos dang 'jig rten dpal 'byor rab rgyas nas/ /'gro don chos bzhin 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa sa skyong gi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs la dpal rgyun gyi dbang po nas bris// ༈ /khams phyogs kyi 'bul bsdud pa'i lam yig bzhugs// shrī bhū mi paṇḍu bhaṭṭa rā ke bhyo na mā mi/ kun dga'i chu gter margad 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /zab don snying po'i lo 'dab stong ldan zhing / /bsod nams mi zad chu ba rab tu brtan/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang rtse mor son la 'dud/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan ches mtho ba/ /kun tu dga' ba'i me tog yur za zhing / /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i rje btsun gang / /'phags mchog sa skya'i bla ma brgyud par 'dud/ /phun tshogs dngos grub gter ba'i rig byed ma/ /khams gsum skye dgu 'gugs pa'i 'dod rgyal dang / /dpal chen tshogs kyi bdag po rnam thos sras/ /dbang sdud nor lha'i tshogs kyi rgyas par mdzod/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po dngos dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka'/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i lung / /rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa dpal ma hā kā la lcam dral gyi 'phrin/ /dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad rnam par rgyal ba'i yi ge/ /chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas brtsams te/ gtsang dbus khams gsum gyi sa lam na yon pa'i bla ma slob dpon/ sde pa so so/ dpon skya che chung / lam 'phrang bsrung mi/ rdzong gzhis tha dad kyi gnyer pa/ gru 'phrang zam pa las sgrol 'don byed mi sne mor bskos pa'i mi sna/ drag zhan/ skya ser/ bod 'brog mi dmangs dang bcas pa rnams la springs pa/sngon gyi dus su/

nged kyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po khu dbon gyi rgya nag dang / bod kyi skye dgu thams cad smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing / chos dang 'jig rten gyi bka' drin chen po bla na med pas bskyangs pa/ /drag zhan thams cad kyi blo la gsal ba de yin/ khyad par nged kyis kyang / dbus gtsang gi sa char bsdad nas rgya bod khams gsum gyi gdul bya 'os su gyur pa rnams la/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi skyong lugs tshul dang mthun par byas yod pas/ gong du mos pa'i bla ma sa skya pa yab sras kyi dus mchod dang / phyi rten/ nang rten/ gser thog g.yu thog sogs kyi zhabs tog khyad par can mi sgrub kha med yod pa nas/ dge ba'i bskul ma gsal 'debs kyi phyir nged rang nges kyi sleb thub pa zhig byung na snyam pa yang yod cing / khyad par mdo khams kyi bla ma/ dpon chen rags rim rnams kyis kyang / kho bo cag ngos kyi sleb dgos tshul rim par byung ba bzhin sleb spro bar yod na'ang / rgyu rkyen ci rigs pa la brten/ ngos kyi sleb ma thub byung pas/ nged kyi mchod g.yog rgyun ring du byas shing phyag len dang zab pa'i gnad la phul du byung zhing / khyad par bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin dge slong nam mkha' rtse mo/ /spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams shing rgyas pa'i ched dang / khyad par nged kyi bla ma sa skya pa yab sras kyi 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir/ khams phyogs kyi grwa pa yon bdag so so la gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas blangs te/ dpon slob 'di rnams brdzangs yod pa/ nged rang la dngos su chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'am/ de ltar ma yin na'ang kho bo cag la shin tu dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ rang rang gi 'byor tshod la dpags pa'i 'bul ba'i dngos po blo nus gang che bsgrub pa dang / kha 'dzin/

bshags 'debs/ grogs dang mthun rkyen du gang 'gro gyis/ de ltar byas pa thams cad kyang / rnam dkar gyi dge ba kho na ma gtogs/ log pa'i 'tsho bar skad cig kyang mi 'gro ba yin/ gong 'khod las 'gal ba'i/ 'di pa dpon slob la dbang che'i she mong / dgra jag rkun gsum/ mi 'os pa'i lam sgyil sogs mdor na gnod 'tshe log sgrub sus byas de/ dpal sa skya'i bstan bsrungs gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' stod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dpal stobs 'phrog nag po zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ chos skyong dkar bdud/ 'khor zhing skyong dregs pa sde brgyad/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma rgyal po pe har 'khor dang bcas pa/ srog gcod gying lnga/ dregs pa gza' gdong dang lcam dral/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i rten phur phyung zhig snying khrag thang la pho cig don snying rnam lnga zhal du gsol cig ji ltar bka' bsgos pa 'di rnams las chos skyong bsrung ma lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyi ma 'da' bar stong grogs mgon skyabs zhi rgyas drag po dbang gi 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod/ sa skya'i rje btsun brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas/ /chos srung nag po chen po nor lha'i tshogs/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'brug lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa nas bris/ maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus// ༈ /rta 'bul ba la gnang ba'i lam yig/ shrī gu ru a dhi de ba tā dharma pā la bhyaḥn maḥ dpal 'khor lo'i mgon dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka'/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i lung /

rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa dpal ma hā kā la lcam dram gyi phrin las/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad la rnam par rgyal ba'i yi ge/ dpal sa skya nas brtsams te/ pho brang chen po ta tu'i bar gyi sa lam na yod pa'i/ gtsang dbus khams/ rgya nag la sogs pa yul khams so so'i bla ma/ slob dpon/ sde srid so so'i dpon skya che chung / lam 'phrang bsrung mi/ rdzongs gzhis tha dad kyi gnyer pa/ gru zam las sgrol 'don byed mi/ sne mor bkos pa'i mi sna/ drag zhan/ skya ser/ bod 'brog mi dmangs dang bcas pa rnams la springs pa/ sngon gyi dus su/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che khu dbon dang / hor gyi rgyal po go dan yab sras yon mchod du sbrel ba nas bzung / /sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams dang / hor gyi rgyal rabs bar ma chad par byung ba rnams kyi ti shrī dang yon bdag gi tshul lugs skyon med pas rgya bod kyi sa cha la chos dang 'jig rten gyi khrims lugs bzhin bskyang 'dug cing / dus phyis/ rgya nag gi rgyal po ta'i ming yun lo de dang / theg chen chos kyi kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis dpon slob thugs snang gcig tu 'dres shing las dang smon lam bzang pos 'brel pa'i rgyal khams chos bzhin du skyong ba'i lung dang / ti shrī'i las kha khyad par can gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ de dag gis bka' srol mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog gis chos khrir gnas pa rnams la/ ti shrī'i las kha dang / rtse gdong gi khrims ra 'dzin pa la/ hu skya ho waṃ gi las kha zhu bar rkang gtad nas/ mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' dpal 'byor dang / gnyer pa kun dga' gzhon nu rnams brdzangs pa yin pas/ 'di pa dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thad du/

khyod drag zhan gong du smos pa thams cad kyis 'bul ba/ zhabs tog snyed bkur/ rang rang so so'i gang 'os kyi bsgrub lugs byas pas/ log pa'i 'tsho bar mi 'gyur zhing / rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams kyi phyi rten dang / nang rten rnams kyi zhig gsos/ tshul dus mchod sogs rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs kho nar 'gyur bas yid la nges pa dang / 'di skad bzlos phyin/ gnod 'gal log sgrub kyi jag choms brku 'phrog dbang che'i bshed mongs byed mi byung na/ dpal sa skya'i chos skyong bstan bsrungs gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ṭi/ dpal lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' stod pu tra/ bha ṭa/ sring mo khrag mig ma/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ 'khor ru 'dren sde bzhi rnams dang / dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ srog bdud shel mig can/ las kyi gshan pa nyer gcig skya shar gri thogs 'bum sde/ mon pho dam khri 'bum sde/ mon mo zha thogs 'bum sde/ klu bdud nag po 'bum sde/ 'khor zhing skyong dregs pa sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams dang / dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum/ chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla/ bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ dam can bka' bsrung bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma chos kyi rgyal po pe har 'khor dang bcas pa dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad thabs cad kyi gnod byed 'di rnams kyi/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i rten phur phyung shig snying khrag thang la pho cig don snying rnams zhal du gsol cig gnod byed 'di rnams skyobs pa'i lha dang phrad nas/ 'bar ba'i hom khung bcug ste/ rdo rje'i thun gyis brabs nas/ rnam smin gyi lus/ dum bu dum bur thong shig ji ltar bka' bsgos nas 'di rnams la chos skyong bsrung ma lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyi ma 'da' bar gtong grogs mgon skyabs ni zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par phrin las mdzod cig

sa skya'i rje btsun brgyud par bcas pa rnams/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas/ /chos bsrungs nag po chen po'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun dbang sdud rig byed lha mo'i sku/ /khams gsum dbang bsgyur 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / /dpal 'byor mchog stsol ga ṇa pa ti yis/ /sa gsum dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgya chen tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i chu gter las/ /legs par mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor lhun po ni/ /phrin las nyi zla'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /'dzam gling chos bzhin rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni sgrol byed kyi lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa la dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /yig mkhan zla grags la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ sad pa'i gnas skabs ni/ phal cher nyin par snang ba thams cad yin te/ gnyid du ma song zhing / bzhi pa'i gnas skabs ma yin pa'i/ sems rtog bcas dang / de la snang ba'i yul gyi rnam pa thams cad do/ /rmi lam gyi gnas skabs ni/ gnyid du song ma thag ma yin pa'i/ rmi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs so/ gnyid 'thug pa'i gnas skabs ni/ gnyid du song ma thag dang / de ma yin pa'i rmi lam mi rmi bar gnyid kyi sems snang thams cad do/ bzhi pa'i gnas skabs ni/ tha mal pa'i dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi skabs su/ phyi nang gi rnam rtog rags pa rnams nub kyang bde ba'i rtog pa gsal bar snang ba'o/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa ni sku rdo rje/ sprul pa'i sku ste bum dbang dang / bskyed rim bsgom zhing sor bsam la brten nas lus dang sa'i gnas skabs sbyong ba'o/ /rnam pa nyi shu pa'i byang chub pa ni/ gsung rdo rje/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste gsang dbang dang srog 'dzin bsgom pas/ ngag dang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs sbyong ba'o/

/rnam pa lngas byang chub pa ni/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi shes rab ye shes dang rjes dran gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pas/ yid dang gnyid thug po'i gnas skabs sbyang ba'o/ /skad cig gcig gis byang chub pa ni ye shes rdo rje/ bde chen gyi sku ste/ dbang bzhi pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pas ye shes kyi khams dang bzhi'i gnas skabs sbyong ba'o/ /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis zla ba grags pa la gnang ba'o// ༈ /rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung 'ga' zhig /dogs pa'i gnas la the tshom kyi/ /dri med sel byed 'di tsam mo/ /snang ba gsum du skal dman rim gyis pa'i lam gso sbyong nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes kyi bar ji ltar 'du gsung ba/ spyir snang ba gsum gyi sgra yangs par byas na/ theg pa che chung lam 'bras thams cad kyang der 'du ba la dgongs nas/ khrid yig la lar de ltar gsungs pa yin mchi/ kho bos de 'dra'i khrid yig ma mthong / re re nas snang ba gsum po 'dir 'dus lugs bshad pa yang ma mthong zhing / bshad kyang dka' ba 'dra/ gzhung nas bshad tshod dang / rang gi go tshod la/ ma dag pa'i snang bar theg pa thun mong gis nyams len rags pa mthun/ des mtshon nas 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre bas/ thun mong gi nyams kyi snang bar theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len 'dus/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang bar sde snod gsum gyi don mtha' dag 'du bar gsungs na sngags thams cad kyi nyams len phal cher los 'dus mod/ 'on kyang bya spyod sogs re re nas bzhag tu mi rung / dbang la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bya spyod dang tshul mthun zhing zab/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnal 'byor rgyud dang cha mthun zab/ dbang gong ma gsum bla med spyi dang mthun cing zab tshul gzhan las gdams ngag 'di pa bsal zhing zab par bstan pa tsam la dgongs pa yin nam snyam/

rigs 'chol zhes pa'i thad ka 'di yigacha yid ches par ma mthong bar/ rang dga' rtog pas sgro btags pas chud zos su 'gyur bas/ rjes su brtag dpyad bya dgos pa gda'/ lam skor phyi ma rnams bde kye/ bdag med ma gang rung gi phyi dkyil du dbang skur ba la khrid ston pa'i lugs yin pa ma gtogs/ de las gzhan pa'i smin byed gzhung so so'i srol la ma byung gda' ba dgongs/ rab 'byams smra bas dris pa'i lan/ /rab gsal go bde'i ngag gi don/ /rab mchog theg pa'i tshul gnas pa/ /rab dkar blo ldan gang des dris/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsā ba/ /kun dga' bsod nams kyis bris so/ /dīrghā yu bha wantu// ༈ /'di yang mkhar spe ba'i dris lan// kun rig sogs rnal 'byor rgyud rnams su rig pa'i dbang lngas/ spang bya dug lnga spong zhing / thob bya ye shes lnga la dbang bar byed pa yin no/ re re yang lnga lngar phye ba ni/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang lta bu'i re re'ang nyon mongs lnga ldan du mtshon la/ ye shes lnga'i re re'ang ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis lnga ldan pa mtshon/ brtul zhugs kyi gtso bo rang don yid byed sbyangs nas/ gzhan don phrin las la dbang byed pa yin no/ /slob dpon gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum/ dam tshig gsum du byin gyis rlobs la/ gu hya dang / dha ri ṇā gnyis kyi thabs shes zung 'jug tu byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ ming dbang la spyir btang rigs lnga char gyi ming 'dogs pa'i lugs yin kyang / zhib tu phye na me tog phog pa'i lha rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje rnon po sogs kyis 'dogs/ skyes pa bud med gnyis la khyad par med/ gnas nyer gnyis la/ spyi bo dang / mgo bo dang / gtsug phud dang spyi gtsug gcig pa yin no/ /rgya gar gyi skad la'ang de ltar yod/ dpral ba dang mdzod spu gcig cing / gzhan rnams so sor bgrangs pas khyab lags/ i ti rab 'byams gzhungs 'dzin pa/

/gang de'i dris lan cung zad de/ /sa skya'i dge slong ā nandas/ /dhyā na gu hya li khi taṃ/ /gcig zhus// ༈ /sa los rab 'byams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ rmi lam dang sems snang tshab tshub mang du 'byung ba de rnams bden 'dzin shas ches pas lan pa yin te/ gang yang nyams gyi snang bar mkhyen bgyis na/ /bdud dang gor sa rang grol dag du 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nyams dga' ba sangs rgyas rang da lta thob pa'am/ sdug bsngal ba da lta rang 'chi ba snyam pa ci ltar byung rung / gang dga' ba gyis/ ci yong ba shog skyid par byung na bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin/ sdug par byung na rang gi las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin par shes pas/ skyid sdug gang byung yang / dga' tshor ba dang / skyo tshor ye mi byed/ 'di kha'i ngang la shi na las 'phro bzang / nga dang 'dra bar skye ba snga mar sgom gyi bag chags ngan cing / bar chad sdang ba'i sems can shin tu mang / de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bar chad rnams nga la smin par gyur cig nga'i bde dge de rnams la 'byung bar gyur cig snyam pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba yang yang bsgom/ /gcod dmigs thob na phung po bzan du thong / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zhen pa spong ba du ma gyis/ cung zad bde bar byung na yang dga' tshor mi byed/ na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin/ bla ma yi dam rnams la dad gus brtan po gyis/ ha cang 'jur drags na mi dga'/ sems tsab tsub dang 'phro 'du mang po ma byed/ sngags mdud dang / bdud rtsi ril bu bco lnga yod/ yang rab 'byams pa de nyid kyi dris lan sa los gnang ba/ thugs dam byed sa byas 'gyur la brtag pa bzang rgyu mi 'dug /sde 'di'i khongs su byas na bzang zer ba byung / yab kyi thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po sogs go cha min/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i go cha zer ba de/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po ces pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka ces pa'i bar kho na yin/

go cha'i bzlas pa byed dus/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ khaṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ mong / hreṃ hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa'i bar tal mar 'don dgos/ 'khor rnams la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la/ oṃ sumbhā ni sumbha ḍā ka nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu/ oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī ri shā ya kā kā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin rigs 'gre sbyor shes sam/ gcig zhus// ༈ /gdong dga' kun spangs pa chos la bskul ba'i gtam nges 'byung dad pa'i ba dan g.yo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ta twa ba dhyantu/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu 'dzin las/ /bde legs char gyi rgyun phab te/ /skye dgu'i nor 'dzin rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'jig rten bya ba kun spangs nas/ /rtse gcig chos la lhur byed pa/ /tshe ring grags pa zhes bya ba'i/ /chos la bskul ba'i gtam gyis ces/ /yang yang nan tan rkyen byas nas/ /'bel ba'i legs bshad 'di sgrogs so/ /'khor ba chu shing lta bur snying po med/ /ci ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /rang don tshe 'di'i bya byed sgrub bsgrub nas/ /glo bur gzhan du 'gro na gdeng yod dam/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i snang tshul ma bsam na/ /chos kyi nyams len phyi bshol du las nas/ /'di phyi'i don rnams yid smon tsam 'gyur bas/ /'phral snang dus kyi 'gyur ba ma gzigs sam/ /pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rting du rab bsgyur nas/ /rang nyid zhi bde kho na bsgrub byas nas/ /theg dman gol ba'i lam du mi 'gyur ram/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / /mi rtag byams dang snying rjer ldan na yang / /byang chub sems gnyis bral ba'i chos gzhan gyis/ /bla med rdzogs byang mi 'grub ma yin nam/ /pha rol phyin pa'i nyams len mthar thug pa/

/bden gnyis zung 'jug lam la 'bad byas kyang / /dbang dang rim gnyis gnad dang mi ldan na/ /myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bas thog mar 'khor ba 'di dag gi/ /gnas tshul sdug bsngal las gzhan med tshul dang / /mi lus chos dang 'phrad pa'ang rnyed dka' zhing / /'chi rkyen mang la 'tsho rkyen nyung bar bsam/ /dge dang mi dge'i blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrub/ /byams dang snying rje smon 'jug byang chub sems/ /khyad par bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems mchog la/ /yang yang nan tan skyed nas sgom par rigs/ /bla ma mchog las dbang bzhi rab thob nas/ /rim gnyis lam la 'bad brtson goms byas te/ /thun mtshams tha mal rnam rtog ma g.yeng ba/ /klog dang kha ton las brjod brtson par bya/ /chos dang bla ma'i skyon la mi rtog cing / /nye ring gang la'ang log lta mi sgom par/ /rang nyid yid ches lam la gtsor byas nas/ /cir snang spros bral lta ba'i dbyings su bskyal/ /gang zag gzhan la dag snang 'byongs pa dang / /rang gi nyams len chig skya thub par bya/ /lta spyod sgom pa'i gnad bkag mi 'gal zhing / /rtse gcig thams su blangs na mi bslu bas/ /yun du bsrings nas sgyid lhug med par bya/ /ji ltar smos pa'i don rnams rags pa tsam/ /khongs su chud na sgom la mi g.yel mdzod/ /'di ni chos la bskul ba dang / /dge sbyor rim pa gsal 'debs yin/ /blo la bzung zhing don bsam na/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung / /sarba sa twā naṃ pa ra mo tsa yantu/ /ces pa chos la bskul ba'i gtam nges 'byung dad pa'i ba dan g.yo ba zhes bya ba 'di ni gdong dga' ba kun spangs tshe ring grags pas yang dang yang du bskul nas/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs anandas dpal sa skya'i ri khrod du bris pa'o/ /e waṃ// ༈ /byas 'gyur ba'i sgrub pa la gnang ba'i dge sbyor la bskul 'debs/ na maḥshrī dza gadgu ru bhyaḥ

dbyings brjod pa kun las rnam grol yang / /don rten 'brel zab mo thugs su chud/ /'phral gsal stong sgyu ma'i 'khyer po can/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag kha rkyang min pa snying gi dkyil/ /yid rtse gcig 'dun pas gsol 'debs na/ /dus 'di nas chos sku mngon gyur bar/ /pha rje btsun khyed kyi thugs rjes bzung / /da snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'di na/ /gzugs chos par bsgyur ba mang lags kyang / /blo tha mal 'dod pa'i khol por lus/ /chos byed blo'i ban gzugs 'di ltar soms/ /rang shes rgyud dug lnga'i rang bzhin la/ /gzhan 'khor ba'i lcong rong nas 'dren pa'i/ /sems snang shas kyi rjes 'brang don med po/ /tshe nges med 'chi ba soms cig aṃ/ /las ci byed sdug bsngal rgyur song yang / /khog bzang por brlom pa'i pom yor 'dis/ /gal che dus yid kyis tsab tsom ldang / /de blang dor gzobs cig shes ldan dag /lar 'khor ba'i 'dug tshul bsam tsa na/ 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal la zad pa med/ /bde 'dod mi dge la 'bad pa'i las ngan can/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu med snying nas soms/ /don yin lugs ci snang bden pa med/ /rang rig stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal dang / /'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char/ /de sems kyi rang bzhin du blo thag chod/ /sems nyid kyang gnyid rdzas nad gdon sogs/ /'khrul byed kyi sprul pa'i rgyu rkyen las/ /'khrul pa'i dngos po du mar snang / /snang bzhin du grub med sgyu ma'i ngang / /kun rdzob snang tsam gyi rten 'brel 'di/ /skad cig snga ma'i dus phyi ma med na'ang / /dus snga phyi'i 'brel pa legs bsam na/ /gang shar rten 'brel du rtogs pa gnad kyi don/ /smra mi shes byis pa'i bzhad gad bzhin/ /don dam par shes brjod yul las 'das/ /'phral rten 'brel snang ba mi 'gag pa'i/ /gnad nges don gyi nyams myong rgyud la skye/ /chos go yul yod pa mang na yang /

/don nyams su myong ba re re tsam/ /tshig kha bshad mang la ma dga' bar/ /blo nang du khug nas nyams len dris/ /phyi tha mal snang ba lha ru bsgom/ /sgra ci grags sngags kyi ngo bor ltos/ /sems rnam rtog ci 'gyur ye shes dang / /bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig thob/ /chos nyams su len dbang yod pa'i dus/ /blo phyi bshol snyoms las le lor lus/ /nam 'jig rten bya brel mang ba'i skabs/ /blo chos la 'gro 'gro'i rdzun zobs 'di/ /sngon chad kyang bslus pa shin tu mang / /da khyed kyang gtan gyi 'dun ma zhig /dus da lta nyid nas ma bsgrubs na/ /'gyod kyang bya thabs med pa cig nges par 'ong / /de yid la chongs las snying rus bskyed/ /sgom byas pa'i yus kyi nga rgyal na/ /sngar yod kyi nyams myong rgyun chad pas/ /rang dma' phab gzhan rnams gtsug tu khur/ /yid skyo shas ngang nas dben par 'dod/ /sems gya gyu ma mang rang tshugs zung / /nyams skyon med skyes nas gzhan gyi don/ /lhun grub 'bad med du 'byung ba legs par dgongs/ /ma 'gro ba kun la snying rje bskyed/ /yid rtse gcig dam pa'i chos la 'bungs/ /'phral lus ngag dge ba ci 'grub gyis/ /phugs bla ma dkon mchog la blo gtad bcol/ /mtha' mi mngon 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag mar gyur 'gro ba sgrol 'dod pas/ /don rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lam sgrub nas/ /dpal kun tu bzang po nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong na bsgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa rnams kyi dge sbyor gyi bskul 'debs dgos zer ba la/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba rig sngags 'chang ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas bris pa dge'o// ༈ /snar thang stong dpon la gnang ba// na maḥshrī dza yā ya/ yul byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na/ /chos dri med rgyal ba'i gsung rab mchog

/don ji bzhin legs rtogs blo gros grags/ /dpal snar thang chos kyi grwa btab nas/ /dus ring zhig lon pa'i skabs kyi tshe/ /sa de yi thig ler nyer gnas pa/ /rigs lang tsho 'byor pa'i dpal gyis phyug /thugs dge ba'i chos la rab gzhol ba/ /dpal nus ldan dbang po bsod nams mtshan/ /khyed dal 'byor lus bzang thob pa'i dus/ /blo chos la dad pa ngo mtshar yang / /don lag tu len pa gal che bas/ /lus yun ring 'tsho ba'i thabs rnams la/ /ches rmad du byung ba'i brtson grus 'tshal/ /'phral lus ngag don yod gnas pa 'di/ /phugs bde ba'i lam du myur du 'jug /sems myos byed btung ba'i ro la chags/ /lus bag med spyod pas dus 'da' na/ /gzhan tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i thabs/ /ji ltar byas kyang don go chung / /de thugs la bzhag nas byang chub sems/ /dus rtag tu mi nyams rgyas pa'i phyir/ /lus ngag gi chos spyod rim pa rnams/ /'chag med du nyams len mdzad pa dang / /zab gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par/ /rlung 'khrul 'khor gyi gtum mo'i dmigs pa sogs/ /me rlung gi nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /cung zad tsam nyams su bzhes 'tshal lo/ /'phral sku la 'phrod pa'i kha zas dang / /spyod lam gyi 'byung ba cha snyoms nas/ /tshad med myos byed kyi dge spro ma mdzad par/ /mi kho bo'i ngag la gsan par mdzod/ /don 'di dag la blang dor mi mdzad na/ /chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba mi 'grub cing / /rang gzhan kun sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ /bsam gzhig gi 'dun ma bgyid 'tshal lo/ /sku lhun po'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /rang srid kun rnam par rgyas pa yi/ /srung 'khor dang smon lam bgyid lags pas/ /thugs dgong pa mthar phyin bkra shis shog /dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis rgyal ba'i tshes la bris pa thugs dam mdzad 'tshal lo// ༈ /blon po rta ra ba sangs rgyas don 'grub la gnang ba//

na maḥshrī wa rā de nā thā ya/ dpal srid zhi'i bdag po ye shes sku/ /don dri med rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin ston/ /thugs bde stong mchog gi rnam rol can/ /pha rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ /bu sangs rgyas don grub la byin gyis rlobs/ /nad med lang tsho gzhon dus/ /'dir snang dga' dga' mang yang / /'chi bdag bdud kyi zin tshe/ /phan nges chos las med pas/ /blo phugs chos la btod cig /chos kyang sang bya gnang bya'i/ /snyoms las le lor lus na/ /mal gyi mtha' mar nye dus/ /skor zhing ngu 'bod byed par/ /nges par 'ong bas sgrims shig /'dus byas thams cad 'jig cing / /khyad par rang gi lus 'di/ /rnam par shes dang bral nas/ /ci bya gtol med yong nges/ /chos la btson pa bskyed cig /'di ltar skyes pa kun kyang / /glog bzhin myur du 'chi bas/ /nam 'chi cha med bsams la/ /snying khongs rus pa'i gting nas/ /'chi chos sha ma mdzod cig /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan mang yang / /zhe nas chos bzhin byed pa/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du/ /nges par dkon pas bsam blo/ /legs par mthong la spyod mdzod/ /dbang gi smin pa'i gang zag /zab mo'i rim gnyis bsgom pa/ /lam gyi mchog yin des na/ /khyed kyang gdams pa cung zad/ /nyams su longs par mdzod cig /da lta rang dbang yod dus/ /cung zad nyams len med na/ /nges par 'gyod pa skye bas/ /snying nas chos la 'dun pa'i/ /bsam pa brtan par gyis shig /snang ba yi dam lhar bsgom/ /brjod pa sngags kyi rang bzhin/ /don la shes brjod las 'das/ /kun rdzob bdag gzhan brje ba'i/ /byang chub sems mchog bsgom shig /ces pa 'di sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dgas bris pa'o// ༈ /rig drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul rtsom 'phro// na maḥshrī rā di pa ra ma ma hā mu dra ya/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' drin can gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gros dngos grub stsol/

/chos skyong srungs mas phrin las sgrubs/ /spyir rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ /dgos rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /ratna wa rdha'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dus 'bral med rgyud la byin gyis rlobs/ /lar rigs drug 'khor ba'i snang tshul 'di/ /ma brtag gcig bu nyams dga' yang / /skyid sdug gi bsam blo btang ba'i tshe/ /las kyi chu bos mthur du khyer/ /thar med sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byings/ /gti mug mun pos dbang po 'tshubs/ /chags pa'i 'dab kyi lus la g.yogs/ /zhe sdang chu srin gyi mche bas gzung / /nga rgyal phrag dog gi zhags pas drangs/ /'khor ba'i gting rdor lhung ba la/ /'dren pa'i re thag chod gyur kyang / /da dung rjes nas bde ba zhig /yong ngo snyom pa'i pho tshod kyis/ /blo bde mor 'dug pa'i 'phrul tshabs can/ /khyad par dmyal ba'i gnas na yang / /tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod klag med/ /lus rdzus skyes bcu drug lo lon tsam/ /skyes ma thag sngar byas kyi las ngan gyis/ /snang ba thams cad dgra bor 'char/ /mtshon chas lus kun thal bar bklag /yang sos zhes bya'i sgra grags pas/ /slar yang sngar bzhin gzhon lus can/ /kha cig gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /gzung nas lus la thig gi 'debs/ /sog le 'bar bas 'dreg par byed/ /la la ri bo'i bar du brtsir/ /kha cig lcags sreg khang pa ni/ /rkyang pa'am nyis rims sgo med du/ /'tshod cing ngu 'bod cho nges 'debs/ /lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gcig dang / /rtse gsum dag gi bshang lam nas/ /spyi bo'i bar du yang yang 'bigs/ /'ga' zhig lcags zangs khru chen du/ /khro chu khol mar 'tshod par byed/ /yang ni lcags sreg sa gzhi la/ /grangs dmyal rnams ni gangs kyi ljongs/ /'khyag pa'i thang la kha ba dang / /a chu kyi hud la sogs pa'i/ /ngu 'bod byed cing la la dag /lus kun tshal pa brgya stong nas/ /bar nas rnag khrag chu ser 'dzag /de yang 'khyags shing gas pa'i bar/

/lags shing mchu yis 'jibs par byed/ /de sogs sdug bsngal brjod mi langs/ /yi dwags zhes bya'i 'jig rten na/ /zas skom gyi sgra yang mi grags par/ /lo zla bskal pa'i bar du 'tshol/ /btsal yang phun rings mi rnyed cing / /ngan ngon chung ngu tsam rnyed pa yang / /kha cig gi thob pa kha cig gi 'phrog /snabs dang lud pa phyil la sogs/ /mi gtsang 'dam la sus thob byed/ /rang dbang bde ba'i skabs med kyang / /gzhan dag sgrub la bar chod stsol/ /las ngan khong khro gdug rtsub kyis/ /lus can yongs kyi srog la 'tshe/ /kye ma 'di 'dra'i skal ba ngan/ /khong dud cing 'gro ba'i byol song rnams/ /rang bzhin glen zhing gti mug pas/ /bya ba yin min gyi shan mi phyed/ /khyad par sha dang pags pa dang / /rus pa bas spu'i ched du gsod/ /srog chad la khad kyang dbyug pa bsnun/ /snying rje med par lcag gis gzhur/ /mi thag khur gyi lus sems la/ /na tshod rgas nas mi nus na/ /da ni gsod pa'i dus ran zer/ /sems ya nga med par sha khrag spyod/ /ri ngogs stong par tswa zos shing / /chu gtsang 'thung pa'i ri dwags kyang / /nyams dga'i rtsed mor bsad nas thal/ /lar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'di/ /bskal par brjod kyang zad mi 'gyur/ /lha min gyi gnas na'ang rang bzhin gyi/ /lha yi dpal la phrag dog pas/ /'thab cing rtsod pa'i g.yul bshams tshe/ /mtshon chas lus kun dum bur bstubs/ /rang gi longs spyod gnas khang kun/ /gzhan gyi 'phrog cing lha dbang gis/ /rdo rje rab tu nyams par byed/ /de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod/ /gnas mtho ris lha yi 'jig rten na/ /dpal 'dod dgu'i longs spyod mtha' yas kyang / /las dge ba'i 'bras bu nyer zad nas/ /de tshe de nas gzhan du 'pho ba'i skabs/ /'chi ltas nye ba'i 'chi ltas rnams pa lnga/ /mthong tshe mnar med kyi sdug bsngal las che// ༈ /rje nyid rang gi thugs dam smon lam tshigs bcad ma//

swasti/ /bdag yid utpal nags tshal nyams dga' bar/ /'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma shar gyur nas/ /dri med ngag gi sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /skal ldan bdud rtsi'i bum pa tshim byed shog /bdag blo'i chu gter che las 'khrungs pa yi/ /legs bshad mu tig bsil ma'i do shal gyis/ /shes ldan gzur gnas don mthun mgon po rnams/ /kun dga'i blo gros ci yang rgyas gyur cig /rnam par dpyod pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas shing / /sgrub dang sun 'byin mche sder rnon po yis/ /log smra'i so ldan dregs pa gzhom nus pa'i/ /'jigs bral smra ba'i seng ger bdag gyur cig /bzo gso sgra tshad nang rig bstan bcos dang / /sdebs sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar la sogs pa/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas la thogs med pa'i/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug nyid du bdag gyur cig /tshul 'di nang gi mgrin par legs 'thon pa/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi rab myongs shing / /yangs pa'i blo gros phyogs kyi gos can la/ /nan gyi 'gran pa lo tsā ānanda// ༈ /dbu rtse snying ma dang / /sgo rum gyi rten gsum rnams gyis dkar chag gi 'go'i tshigs bcad// na maḥshrī badzra dha rā di yo ge shwa rashtsa dwa ya bhaṭṭa rā ka ba su dha ra bhū mi paṇḍū ka bhyaḥwā ge sha mañdzu badzrā ya pra ṇa mā mi/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter dang gnyis med grub pa'i 'khor lo sgyur ba mthu stobs mgon po zhes grags snyan pa'i gdugs dkar khor yug ri mo'i rtse mo la/ /ches cher gsal bar 'thon pa gang gi thugs rje rnam par dkar ba'i 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i 'jig rten dbang po kun dga'i mtshan/ /de nyid rigs kyi thig le las 'ong 'jam pa'i dpal nyid gzhon nu'i tshul ston bsod nams rtse mo gsang chen mdzod 'dzin grags pa'i rgyal mtshan cher bsgreng ba/ /phyi nang shes bya'i rig gnas kun mkhyen chos rjes paṇḍi ta dang de sras mthu bo chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/

/rab dkar kai la sha yi sa 'dzin ngos la bsil zer byed pa'i 'od kyi rnam par khebs pa lta bur shin tu dkar zhing dngas pa'i sku mchog ni/ /rab mdzes rnam thar rang bzhin zhal gyis dkyil 'khor re re bzhin yang 'dren byed utpal zung dang zla ba'i phreng ba gnyis skyes ze'u 'brus nye bar brgyan/ /rab mchog 'phags lam mtshon byed phyag gi yal ga thabs dang shes rab dag pa'i zhabs zung rdo rje'i dkyil krung legs bcas bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs/ /rab tu dad pa'i yid kyi kun tu bstod cing phyag 'tshal 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor rgyas shing brtan pa'i bde legs stsol/ /dpal ldan int+ra nī la'i lhun po'i mdangs 'phrog rnam par brjid pa'i drag shul sku ni mtshams sprin ral pa gyen du langs shing 'khyil pas rab tu dkrigs/ /rta ljang byed ba'i tsha zer rab 'phro bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me ltar dmar zhing bgrad pa'i sdang mig lta bas gshin rje'i gtso bo'ang skrag par mdzad/ /rno zhing gzengs rings mche ba'i myu gu zla tshes lta bur rnam par gtsigs la drag po'i khro gnyer char sprin nang nas ljags kyi glog stong rab 'khyug cing / /hūm̐ phaṭa sprin gyi rnga chen mi bzad sgrogs la rdo rje'i mtshon cha bsnams nas bdud dpung tshar gcod chos 'khor skyong mdzad bsrung ma'i dbang po rtag tu rgyal/ /rmad byung shin tu dmar ba'i byu ru'i sdong po nyi gzhon 'char ka'i mdangs kyis rnam par byugs pa'i li khri'i sku ni sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /lha dang mi yi nor bu mchog gis nye bar brgyan zhing skye dgu'i yid kyi padma 'gug byed rab tu bkra ba'i sna tshogs gos kyi lhab lhub can/ /dbang gi phrin las thogs med bsgrub mdzad rje btsun rig byed lha mo kā ma rā dza dpal ldan tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs 'dod pa'i lha rnams dang /

/'jig rten 'di yi 'dod dgu kun stsol bsam 'phel nor bu'i gter gyi bdag po rnam thos sras dang dzambha la sogs gnas 'di skyong zhig rgyas par mdzod/ /de ltar mchod par brjod cing dge legs kyi tshigs bcad sngon du song nas sgrol byed ces pa chu mo lug gi lo gro zhun gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa rim par byon pa'i gnas/ /legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad du/ /shrī bhū mi paṇḍu ka sarba gu ṇā ka ra bho ṭa sya badzra sa na nā maḥ bod skad du dpal sa skya yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas ces bod kyi rdo rje gdan ces bya ba/ ༈ /sgo rum dpe khang gi dkar chag/ shrī bhū mi paṇḍu ka bhaṭṭa ra ke bhyo nā mā mi/ kun dga'i chu gter mar rgad 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /zab don snying po'i lo 'dab stong ldan zhing / /bsod nams mi zad chu ba rab tu brtan/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang rtse mor son la 'dud/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan ches mtho ba/ /kun tu dga' ba'i me tog g.yur za zhing / /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i rje btsun mchog /'phags pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsis mtsho gyur cig /de ltar dam pa rnams kyi gsung rab las/ /legs bshad skyes su bya phyir glegs bam gyis/ /snang brnyan gzhan du mi 'thor bsdu ba'i phyir/ /ā li kā li'i phreng ba 'di ltar ro/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma lnga'i phyag dpe gtso che ba sngon gyi dus su po ti stong phrag phyed dang gnyis lhag tsam dpe khang 'di nyid na bzhugs par grags kyang / bstan 'dzin so sos phyogs gzhan du spyan drangs pa'i lhag ma/ da lta lag yod kyi phyag dpe gsang sngags phyogs la/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog dus 'khor/ gsang 'dus/ gshin rje/ yo ga bya spyod skor/ rnying ma rnams dang / mdo phyogs la phar phyin/ sgra tshad/ sman spyad sogs bkod pa la thog mar/ swasti rastu/

༈ /tshe lha dang nor lha'i tshigs bcad// rdo rje'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ /'chi med dpal la nyer spyod pa'i/ /rgyal dbang kun gzigs gtso bo yid/ /phyogs der bde legs stsol gyur cig /shrī da na dā ne de be bhya dza wantu/ phun tshogs dngos grub gter ba'i rig byed ma/ /khams gsum skyed dgu 'gugs pa'i 'dod rgyal dang / /dpal chen tshogs kyi bdag po rnam thos sras/ /dbang sdud nor lha'i tshogs kyi rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// ༈ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du/ /snam sbyar phul ba'i kha yig/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byin rlabs nus mthu'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang / /dpag yas mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten mgon/ /rigs gsum rnam 'phrul sa skya pa la 'dud/ /gang gi sku brnyan mdzes pa'i snam sbyar 'di/ /shākya'i dge slong sa skya lo tsā ba/ /ā nanda yis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /rnam grol ye shes nyi ma 'bar gyur cig /a dhiṣtha na kurbantu oṃ swā hā// ༈ /bla ma rin 'byung gser khang na bzhugs pa la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig la// na mo gu ru ratna sambha ya/ kun mkhyen kun gyi gzugs can bla ma'i sku/ /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rab rgyas pa/ /yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan snang brnyan mchog /mdzes byed cod pan yid 'ong 'di phul bas/ /gnas skabs kun tu rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i nang rten snyan dar kha yig/ swasti/ rje btsun bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen gyi/ /nang rten rgyal ba'i sku yi snyan shal mchog /mdzes byed dar gyi cod pan 'di phul bas/ /dge bas 'gro kun thugs rje 'dzin gyur cig /maṅga laṃ shu bhontu// ༈ /sgo rum mgon chen snyan dar kha yig/ swasti/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po la/

/dam rdzas mchod gtor spyan gzigs legs 'phul gyis/ /sa skyong rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /sku tshe brtan cing chab srid rab rgyas te/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi rgyal rnga cher bsgrags pas/ /rgyal khams 'jam dar bde zhing skyid pa dang / /snyan grags ba dan phyogs su rgyas par mdzod/ /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /pu tra la/ shrī karma nā tha pu tra dza wantu// dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po yi/ /bka' stod las mkhan pu tra khyod/ /mchod gtor spyan gzigs 'di bzhes la/ /mi dbang rin chen spungs pa yis/ /nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang / /sku tshe dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// ༈ /rtsed pa nam mkha' ba'i 'bul ba la snyan dar kha yin gnang ba// swasti/ ma hā ka la lcam tral dang / /zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa/ /las mgon pu tra lcam sring sogs/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /dge bsnyen ngag gi dbang pos phul/ /'di phyi'i bar chad zhi ba dang / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// ༈ /sgo rum mgon khang du mgon chen la/ gzhis kha rin spungs nas mo dar gyi gtor sgrub dang mda' dar phul ba la kha yig gnang ba/ shrī badzra pañtsa ra nā tha ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā lī de ba re batyai/ dpal ldan rgyal ba'i ye shes drag po'i skur/ /nye bar bstan nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan dang de 'dzin legs par bsrung mdzad cing / /ma rungs tshar gcod lcam dral 'khor bcas rgyal/ /gang de mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas kyi/ /mchod pa'i sprin phreng bzhed dgu'i ba liṃ tshogs/ /snyug phran gṛ dha kṣis rtse brgyan zhing / /mgul par ne dra'i cod pan legs bcings pas/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mda' rtse rno ldan 'di/ /khams gsum dbang bsgyur ngag gi dbang po mchog /skabs gsum dpal 'gran rin chen spungs pa'i khrir/ /brtan par 'khod pa gang des rtse gcig yid/ /dad pas nyer bslang gus pas 'bul lags na/
