/mi dbang khu dbon yab sras blon 'bangs bcas/ /dbu 'phangs mtho zhing sku tshe mthar phyin te/ /chab srid dar rgyas phas rgol zil mnan nas/ /rang sde phyogs kun rnam par rgyas par mdzod// ༈ /yang mgon chen la/ na maḥshrī badzra pañtsa ra nā thā ya gang sku dbang sngon lhun po brjid pa'i sku/ /gang gsung dbyar skyes sgra brgya'i zab mo'i gsung / /gang thugs zag med mchog gi bde stong thugs/ /gang du'ang thogs med drag po'i phrin las can/ /bstan bsrung lcam dral 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /bzhed dgu'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs 'di 'bul gyi/ /sa skyong rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal mchog /sku tshe bskal par brtan cing chab srid kyang / /phyogs mthar rgyas nas mi nyams 'phel ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin dam pa rnams/ /yun ring zhabs brtan rtag tu bkra shis pa'i/ /phrin las 'bad mer myur du 'grub par mdzod// ༈ /pu tra lcam dral la/ nā maḥshrī karma nā tha ya/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po yi/ /phrin las myur bsgrub las mgon mchog /dam can pu tra lcam sring dang / /brgya bzhi'i dmag tshogs sde brgyad bcas/ /dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod gtor dang / /thugs zung 'dun pa'i rdzas 'di dag /legs par 'bul gyi dges par mdzod/ /sa spyod ngag dbang 'khor bcas rnams/ /sku yi 'tsho ba yun ring brtan/ /lo zla'i skeg sogs mi mthun phyogs/ /mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba dang / /thugs dgongs ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ༈ /yang mgon chen la/ shrī ma hā kā lannā mā mya haṃ/ rgyal ba'i phrin las bstan pa skyong mdzad drag po'i skur ston dpal 'bar gur gyi mgon po'i drung / /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin legs par bsrung ba'i thugs dam bskul phyir dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya chen dang / /rgyal ba'i rtag ldan snyug bzang rgod kyis sgros brgyan rab mdzes dar dmar cod pan phur lding 'gying bag g.yo ba can/ /rgyal ba'i ya lad gus pas 'bul lo sa spyod ngag gi dbang po sku tshe brtan zhing dbu 'phang chab srid mtho bar mdzod//

༈ /pu tra la/ na ma shrī karma nā tha yakṣa pu tra ya/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyis/ /bka' nyan las mkhan mon bu pu tra la/ /dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod gtor rgya chen dang / /spyan gzigs mda' dar la sogs legs 'bul gyi/ /nus ldan ngag gi dbang po khu dbon dang / /blon 'bangs 'khor bcas legs par bsrung zhing skyobs/ /sku tshe rab brtan dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /chab srid kun tu mi nyams 'phel bar mdzod/ /sa ma ya rakṣun tu// ༈ /pu tra la/ shrī karma nā tha pu tra sa dā bi dza yantu/ rdo rje nag po'i bka' stod mchog /las kyi mgon po char sprin mdog /ral gri thod khrag legs bsnams pa'i/ /khams gsum srog bdag chen po rgyal/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / /rgod sgros brgyan pa'i mda' dar 'di/ /dpal ldan rin chen spungs pa nas/ /nus ldan ngag gi dbang pos phul/ /sa bdag sku tshe brtan pa dang / /mnga' 'bangs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / /gnod byed dgra bgegs dpung bcom nas/ /rang srid rnam par rgyas par mdzod// ༈ /sde pa zil gnon pa'i mda' dar la kha yig gnang pa/ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la ya/ rdo rje gur gyis mgon po la/ /mdzes pa'i gcod pan 'di phul bas/ /mi dbang zil gnon rdo rje yi/ /sku tshe brtan zhing rgyas gyur cig/ ༈ /pu tra la/ las mgon ma hā pu tra la/ /dar dkar cod pan legs 'bul gyi/ /sa skyong zil gnon rdo rje la/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod// ༈ /chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims pa'i gdung rten dngul gyi mchod rten la bsngags pa bkra shis kyi mgrin dbyangs zhes bya ba rgyal rtse'i nas zhus pa lags/ swasti prā dza bhyaḥ dge legs bye ba'i margad phung po 'khyil zhing sbu ba'i phreng ba rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams lag bgro'i dbang po rnams kyi bsti gnas dpal gyi 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dkon mchog nor bu dbang gi rgyal po gtsug tor stegs la nye bar bkod nas dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab brtan kun tu bcings shing khrims gnyis gser gyi khri la mthon por 'jog te bslu med bden pa'i skyabs kyi drin las chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor bzang po lhan cig 'dzoms pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po gang gis rin chen dngul gyi rgyu tshogs shas che gser dang tampa'i phung po la/

/dge bar bskrun pa'i lhun po'i dpal la 'gran bzod dri med rin chen du ma'i rdul brtsegs rmad byung lha yi gzhal med khang ni dpal ldan 'jig rten che dgu rnams kyi mchod 'os byang chub chen po'i rten mchog de ni dge ba bcu yis khri 'phang steng du bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i bang rim kun nas mdzes shing thugs rje chen po zla ba yongs su gang ba'i gdan la rab dkar kunda'i phung po 'gyur med chos kyis lhun gyi grub pa'i bum par rnam thar bzhi yi rang bzhin 'jigs med gdong lnga'i khri la zag med bde chen yan lag bdun ldan kun tu bzang po ratna shī la'i sku gdung mchog /dge legs spel zhing brtan par bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs gzi byin ches ches 'od 'bar gzhan yang mtha' yas rgyal dang rgyal ba'i myu gu kun gyi sha ri ram dang ke sha la sogs du mas kun tu gang ba'i rtse mor so so yang dag rig pa'i ngos bzhi dang ldan bre phul steng na mchog sgrogs zhi ba'i lam gyi padmas btegs pa'i rab dga' la sogs bcu gsum pa yi chos kyi 'khor lo gzhan phan nor bu kun nas 'bar ba'i tog can char khebs rnam mang thabs tshul rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog ma rig gnyid las rnam sad ngo mtshar 'di nyid ni/ /dge ba'i bsam pa brtan por 'chang ba'i lha yi rig byed nam mkha' 'joms zhes bya bas lag pa'i 'du byed nye bar bsgrubs te gzhan yang dpag med dge ba'i las la gcig tu brtson pa'i yo byad sbyor dang tshig gi phan 'dogs byed po mtha' dag gtso byas kun gsal mtha' dang mnyam pa'i skyed dgu 'di rnams 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyon mongs drung nas bcom zhing rnam dkar bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs te rnam kun mchog ldan de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i kun tu bzang po nyid gyur de lta'i sdebs sbyor bkra shis dbyangs 'di dpal la sa skya lo tsas sbyar ba'o//

༈ /du 'khor bstod pa// rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra sya sto traṃ na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan chos sku'i lha lam rab yangs par/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sku rta ljang can/ /sprul pa'i snang brnyan tsha zer brgya 'gyed la/ /rtag tu 'grus pa gdod ma'i mgon de rgyal/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od can sku ni chu gter zhal/ /yon tan mgul par zla bas lhag pa yi/ /'byung ba'i phrag ldan spungs pa padma'i gnyen/ /zhabs zung rgyal ba'i phyag gi dge legs mdzod/ /dngos 'dzin rnam rtog chu srin rgyal mtshan can/ /mtshan mar zhen pa'i mgrin sngon dga' mar bcas/ /chags sdang dus kyi me dang sgra gcan te/ /thabs shes rol pa'i gar mdzad gtsug na dge/ /tha mal rnam rtog sbyong byed lha yi sku/ /gzung 'dzin ro rkyang rlung dang byang chub sems/ /nyi zla'i 'gro rnams dhū tir 'jug pa'i lam/ /yan lag drug ldan nyams su len byed cing / /nyams myong mthar phyin dam tshig sdom par gnas/ /yun ring 'tsho dang 'byor pa'i dpal gyi phyug /bsgrub la brtson zhing phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi/ /spyod pa'i mtshams sbyar sku lnga'i bdag nyid shog /ces pa 'di dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myur bar bris pa'o// ༈ /gur mgon bstod pa// hūm̐ḥ 'jigs pa'i nyams ldan dbang sngon lhun po'i sku/ /mtshams sprin ral pa nyi zla'i sdang mig can/ /mche ba'i myu gus srid gsum za bar byed/ /rdo rje'i bsrung ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// ༈ /dmar po skor gsum bstod pa// 'gro kun dbang sdud rig byed lha mo dang / /khams gsum 'gugs mdzad ṭa ki rā dza dang / /dpal 'byor mchog stsol ga ṇa pa ti yis/ /dgos 'dod char 'bebs gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad//

༈ /mnga' ris rgyal po la gnang ba'i bstod pa/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dha rm+ma rā dza a ba nā nanda bi dza ya sya pra ṇa ba mā mṛ ta surṇaṇa ma hā dundu bhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rgyal po khri lde kun dga' rnam rgyal la rab tu bsngags pa'i 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba/ rje btsun smra ba'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas bsod nams gser gyi khrir 'khod nas/ /rang srid kun la dga' ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ /gzhan sde mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /khri lde'i gdung 'dzin chos rgyal rtag tu dge/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rgyal rigs thig le las/ /nye bar 'khrungs pa'i gzhon nu'i rol rtsed kyi/ /nam yang skye dgu'i yid kyi nyer 'tsho yang / /chos kyi rgyal po rab tu bsngags par 'os/ /legs byas dbang sngon 'khyil pa'i chu gter dbus/ /dal 'byor lus bzang 'dam skyes sdong bu ni/ /chos srid dpal 'byor margad yal 'dab can/ /phan bde'i 'bras bus brgyan pa de la 'dud/ /chab srid gser ris bskor ba'i rol mtsho 'phreng / /sbyin dang snyan smra'i rba rlabs cher g.yo zhing / /don spyod rin chen sna bzhi'i lhun po'i ngos/ /don mthun nyi zla'i 'gros ldan gang de rgyal/ /nye ring med pa byams pa'i phyag gi 'dzin/ /kun la snyoms pa thugs rje'i spyan ras gsal/ /mi dge kun sdom tshul khrims zhags pa yis/ /'khor ba'i 'dam las sgrol mdzad de la 'dud/ /'di ltar bde legs 'byung gnas dam pa khyed/ /nam yang srid mtha'i bar du zhabs brtan cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i dpal mgon mdzad du gsol/ /rnam dkar phrin las rab tu rgyas gyur te/ /'jig rten 'khrug long nye bar zhi ba dang / /dpag med 'gro ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i kun mkhyen nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rigs rus cho 'brang du mas mtho ba dpal lha btsan po'i rgyal brgyud khri kun dga' rnam rgyal lde zhes grags pa la bstod pa zhig dgos ces rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyi bskul ba la brten nas dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o//

༈ /byang pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa la bstod pa/ /shrī swasti/ mañdzu badzrā ya na mā mi/ kun dga'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i 'od gzugs ni/ /bkra shis dge mtshan du ma'i bsil zer can/ /sa gsum mgrin sngon ral pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /dpal 'byor bzang po rtag tu stsol la 'dud/ /nam yang kun dga'i 'chi med lam yangs par/ /phan bde bkra shis 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ /mun can g.yul las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma can/ /dpal ldan rta bdun bzang po gang der 'dud/ /gangs can skye dgu kun dga'i pad tshal mchog /bkra shis lo 'dab bye ba rab rgyas shing / /rgyal ba'i mtshan bzang chu ba ches brtan pa'i/ /dpal gyi ze'u 'bru 'dam skyes dbang por 'dud/ /bsod nams rin chen lhun po'i bdag gi ngos/ /rim gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rab gsal zhing / /phrin las gzi 'od phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan brtan g.yo bdag po de la 'dud/ /sgo gsum gyis 'dud dngos 'byor mchod sprin 'bul/ /dus gsum sdig pa bshags shing dge ba'i las/ /rigs gsum gyis bskrun rjes su yi rangs bgyi/ /theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /lung rig gser gyi khri la rab 'dzegs te/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i blon 'bangs legs skyong zhing / /rdo rje'i zhabs rdul brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa yi/ /dge ba kunda'i phung po gang thob des/ /shākya'i bstan pa yun du rgyas pa dang / /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces 'di yon tan rin chen gyis/ /nye bar bskul nas sa skya pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba ā nandas/ /bkra shis bde rgyas gling du bris// ༈ /gu ge ba nam mkha' brtan pa la bstod pa gnang ba/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku ru ā ka sha ḍ-i dho sya sto traṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma nam mkha' brtan pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba/

dpal bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs mtha' dag legs sbyangs nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs pa'i mkhyen rab dang / /rab tu brtan pa'i byang chub thugs ldan pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdung ba'i shugs kyis gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis nye bar 'tsho mdzad cing / /byin rlabs snying gi dkyil du 'jug par shog /mang thos dmar ser ral pa'i khur gyis brjid/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho gsar pa'i lus rgyas shing / /thub pa'i gsung rab mchog gi kha ba'i rir/ /legs gnas blo gsal ri dwags skyong la 'dud/ /rnam pa kun du log smra'i wa skyes tshogs/ /mthar byed dngos stobs rigs pa'i gad rgyangs kyis/ /bdag tu lta ba'i ri bo rab brnyil te/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid du rtogs par shog /legs bris sna tshogs rin chen lhun po'i steng / /dbyibs mdzes lta na sdug pa'i chos kyi khrir/ /rnam mang legs bshad sgra dbyangs sgrog mkhas pa/ /legs bris gzhon nu'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /nam yang brtson 'grus mchog gi go cha dang / /byang chub sems kyi g.yul ngo rab bshams pas/ /nyon mongs sbyin ma'i bu las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /chos sku'i khang bzang mchog la mnga' bsgyur shog /skye ba 'di dang gzhan yang tshe rabs tu/ /tshul khrims thos pa'i nor gyis rgyud phyug cing / /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes bzung nas/ /srid zhi'i bde dge rgya mtsho 'byung gyur cig /ces pa chos kyi rje nam mkha' brtan pa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di yang / de nyid kyi slob ma chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa sangs rgyas shes rab kyi bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong lo tsā ba ā nanda dpal sa skyar bris pa'o// ༈ /dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan po dkon mchog tshul khrims la gnang ba'i bstod pa// rgya gar skad du/

gu ru ratna shī la sya sto traṃ na ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma dkon mchog tshul khrims la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog lhag par dges pa'i tshul khrims can/ /gcig tu phan par dgongs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog brnyes pa/ /skal bzang skye dgu'i mgon khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mang du gsan pa'i chu gter ska rags can/ /rmang byung bsam pa'i rin chen rdul rtsegs shing / /mtha' bral bsgom pa'i bang rim bkod mdzes pa/ /gsung rab kun gyi lhun po la༞ rig gnas gsal bar mkhyen pa'i 'od stong can/ /lhag par gzhan la brtse ba'i ku mud gnyen/ /nam yang gzhal med nus mthu'i rgyu skar phreng / /nyer mdzes 'chi med lam khyod༞ yid 'ong 'chad pa'i ngag gi chu skyes dang / /sdebs legs rnar snyan rtsom pa'i ku mutta/ /gzhan gzhung tshar gcod rigs pa'i rgya mtsho skyes/ /legs bshad skyed mos tshal khyod༞ sgra tshad la sogs phyi nang rig pa'i gnas/ /ji bzhin mkhyen nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa/ /rim gnyis grub pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje/ /rnam pa kun tu mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i snang ba ji snyed pa/ /byams dang snying rjes nyams kyi snang bar bsgyur/ /sku gsum dag pa'i snang ba legs thob nas/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i nyams len mthar phyin shog /rang bzhin brjod pa kun bral rgyu yi rgyud/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi gsal byed lam gyi rgyud/ /lhun grub bde chen grub pa 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /'di yang rnam dpyod gsal ldan pa/ /shākya'i btsun pa ā nandas/ /ring nas bskul ba'i zhal ngor bgyis/ /dge bas 'gro kun chos skur shog/ ༈ /lo dgon pa'i spyan snga ba la gnang ba'i bstod pa/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sampat+sa ra kāntā ra a gra to wa ge sha dharma kīrdhi shrī bha tra sto traṃ nā ma/

bod skad du/ dpal lo dgon pa'i spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags dpal bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ /rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ngag gi dbang pos byin rlabs pas/ /rmad byung lung rtogs dam chos smra ba'i gtso/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan srid na mngon mtho ba/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra tshad rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i mchog /legs gsung 'dul ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag /nges don zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu tshul khrims 'bar zhes pa'i/ /seng ge'i khri la rnam rtsen chos kyi rje/ /gangs can dpal du yun ring zhabs brtan cing / /phrin las nyi 'od kun du gsal gyur cig /ces pa 'di dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /blo gros rab gsal la bstod pa shlau ka gcig po 'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad/ /pra dza yantu/ dge legs tshogs gnyis kun gsal rab yangs par/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor blo gros bsil zer can/ /rab gsal gdul bya kunda'i gnyen gyur pa'i/ /smra ngan mun sel gshin rje de la 'dud// ༈ /mgon po dbang phyug pa la bstod pa 'di yang mdzad/ /swasti/ dpal ldan dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung nas/ /snyan rgyud gdams pa'i rgya mtsho rnam mang po/ /phrin las 'od zer phyogs kun gsal mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi dbang phyug bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ༈ /thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa pa bkra shis brtan pa la bstod pa// mañdzu shrī bā de sidha ya na maḥ bkra shis dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan cher bzung nas/ /brtan zhing dul ba'i khur ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan smra ba'i dbang phyug de la 'dud/ /rgya che mdo dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la/ /'jigs med 'chad dang rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod nas/

/skal bzang skye dgu'i dpal gyur chos kyi rje/ /bkra shis brtan pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang du thos pa'i lus stobs ches rgyas shing / /bsam byung rigs pa'i gser gyis ral pas brjid/ /nges don bsgom pa'i mche sder rab bgrad nas/ /log lta'i ri dwags skrag mdzad de la 'dud/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /zab gsal ting 'dzin lo 'dab cher rgyas nas/ /shes rab me tog 'bras bus rnam bkra ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam dbang po de la 'dud/ /legs byas rin chen lhun po'i ba gam ngos/ /phrin las thabs shes nyi zla'i 'gros chen gyis/ /gdul bya gling bzhi'i khor yug kun gsal ba'i/ /brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid gang der gus pas 'dud/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis rtag tu mchod/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi dge'i las rnams so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rnam dkar dge ba kun la rjes yid rangs/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /sems can don du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dge bas mar gyur skye dgu mtha' dag kyang / /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni don du gnyer ba'i grwa pa mang pos yang yang bskul nas dpal sa skya lo tsā ba ā nandas myur ba bris pa'o// ༈ /chos rje dpal ldan rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa gnang ba/ /na mo bā di singha ya/ dpal ldan mkhyen rab kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos/ /rab dkar thugs rje bdud rtsi'i 'od can gyis/ /phrin las bsil zer 'bum phrag mngon gsal ba/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan bzang ldan pa gang der 'dud/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag las legs nos te/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son gyur pa'i/ /rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /thos pa'i don rnams dri med bsam pa yis/ /legs par bskyangs shing nges par gzigs nas kyang / /drang nges don la yid gnyis rab spangs te/

/zab don mchog gis gter chen de la 'dud/ /thun mong byang chub sems gnyis cher brtan zhing / /nges don lha dang ye shes 'khor lo yis/ /'khrul snang gzung 'dzin mtha' dag nyer 'joms pa'i/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de la bdud/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgyas mtshos mchod/ /mi dge bshags shing dge la rje yi rangs/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog /ces 'di sa skya lo tsā ba ānanda yis myur bar bris/ /maṅga laṃ swasti rdhantu// ༈ /thun bstan yangs pa can gyi gdan sa pa la gnang pa'i bstod pa/ /rgya gar skad du/ kīrti sya dhwa dza sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang thos nags kyi dpag bsam ljon pa'i dbus/ /tshul bzhin bsam pa'i mche sder rab rno ba/ /nges don bsgom pa'i sdang mig gad rgyangs can/ /lung rigs smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal/ /legs bshad 'chad pa'i 'od dkar stong 'phro zhing / /dri med rtsom pa'i ri bong thig le can/ /phyi rol smra ngan mun pa las rgyas ba'i/ /rigs lnga'i dbang phyug mtshan mo'i mgon der 'dud/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ngur smrig gos bzang can/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin lang tsho rnam par rgyas/ /rgya chen drang nges 'byed pa'i shes rab can/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i dpang po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kun rdzob lha yi 'khor lor rab rtogs shing / /don dam zung 'jug rang byung ye shes kyis/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de nyid legs mkhyen pa'i/ /grub pa mchog gi srol 'dzin de la 'dud/ phyi nang gsang gsum mchod phrin rgya mtshos mchod/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i las rnams bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rigs gsum gdul bya'i tshogs la brtser dgongs nas/ /grangs med gsum du brtan par bzhugs nas kyang /

/shākya'i bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel ba dang / /phrin las nyi byed kun tu rgyas gyur cig /ces dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa bkra shis rol mtsho zhes bya ba dpal sa skya lo tsā ba mañdzu gho ṣā a nandas bris pa'o// ༈ /skyo rtsi mkhan po rdor 'dzin la gnang ba'i bstod pa// swasti/ phun tshogs dge legs nam mkha'i ngos yangs par/ /rim gnyis rta ljang nor bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma brnyes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag gang der 'dud/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i phrin las mthar phyin te/ /rjes su rnal 'byor grub pa'i rtogs pa shar/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zab mo'i mthar thug pa/ /rdzogs chen grub pa'i dbang phyug de la 'dud/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa'i las kun bshags/ /rnam dkar dge la rtag tu rjes yi rangs/ /gsang sngags smin grol 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'gro ba'i don du yun ring brtan par bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i nyi 'od kyi/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i pad tshal mchog /rab tu rgyas shing kun bzang nyid gyur cig /'di ni skye rtsa bla ma yi/ /nye bar bskul nas sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge slong skad gnyis smra/ /ā nanda yis myur bar bris// ༈ /gting skyes pa kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa 'di yang sa skya lo tsā ba la tsand+ra kī rtis zhus pa dge/ swa sti/ mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas kun legs sbyangs nas/ /rab dga'i spyod pas skal ldan tshogs rnams la/ /bkra shis phan bde stsol mdzad chos kyi rje/ /mkhas shing grub pa mnyes la gsol ba 'debs// ༈ /rdo rje seng ge la bstod pa 'di yang zhus pa dge/ 'di nyag re gser mdog pa'i bla ma la bstod pa gnang ba// swasti/ rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i ting 'dzin las/ /nam yang g.yo med lhag pa'i tshul khrims can/ /dbang lung man ngag smra ba'i seng ge mchog

/yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// ༈ /shrī bi dza yantu/ dge legs gser gyi khri la rtag 'khod nas/ /nam yang chos la 'dud pa'i spyan ras gyis/ /rgya chen lung rigs smra ba'i gad rgyang can/ /'jigs med seng ge'i mtshan can zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chi med lam yangs par/ /legs bshad 'od gzugs 'bar ba'i nor bus mtshan/ /phrin las bzang po 'od zer brgya phrag 'gyed/ /yongs 'dzin rta bdun rgyal po de la 'dud/ /kun dga'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i thig le ni/ /man ngag ri bong gzugs kyi rnam par spras/ /snyan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsil zer stong 'phro ba'i/ /bshes gnyen bdud rtsi'i 'od can de la 'dud/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /byang chub sems gnyis dbang sngon myu gu 'khrungs/ /gsang chen rim gnyis nor bu'i 'bras bu can/ /sdom gsum dpag bsam ljon pa de la bdud/ /tshad med gdul bya gling bzhi'i dbus na brjid/ /byams dang snying rje'i bang rim lhag par mdzes/ /rang gzhan don gnyis nyi zla'i 'gros chen can/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan gling bzhi gsal la 'dud/ /de ltar phyag tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sdig pa bshags shing dge la rjes yi rangs/ /mtha' yas skye dgu smin grol la bkod nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyag re gser mdog pa'i bla ma la bstod pa don gnyer 'ga' zhig gi bskul nas/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba ā nandas myur bar bris pa'o// ༈ /jo nang mkhan chen dpal ldan rin chen la gnang ba'i bstod pa// rgya gar skad du/ gu ru shrī bānda ma hā ratna sye sto traṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma dpal ldan rin chen la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge legs bye ba'i dpal gyi rab mdzes sku/ /'jig rten byed pa'i dbyangs ldan rab snyan gsung / /zag med bde bas rnam rol nyer zhi'i thugs/

/rin chen gsum dngos chos kyi rje la 'dud/ /sngon bsags bsod nams rmad du byung ba'i mthus/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i sa brnyes dge ba'i bshes/ /dam pa rnams las legs bshad nyer nos te/ /mkhyen rab thogs pa mi mnga' de la 'dud/ /khyad par rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /rigs 'dzin sngags kyi theg pa'i nye lam mchog /dpal ldan dam pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang dang gdams pa mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /grol ba'i lam gyi rang gi rgyud smin nas/ /snyigs dus skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /zab mo'i snyan brgyud dus gsum 'doms mdzad pa'i/ /don gnyis grub pa'i dbang phyug de la 'dud/ /chos kun 'od gsal nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dang / /rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab dbyer med pa/ /legs gzigs brtse ba chen po'i thugs mnga' ba/ /rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po de la 'dud/ /gzung 'dzin so sor snang ba sdud byed lam/ /gnyis med ye shes bsam gtan la gnas shing / /srog rtsol rlung sems dbu mar brtan byas nas/ /'gyur med bde bar 'dzin pa'i lam bsgom shog /mtha' bral zung du 'jug pa'i rjes dran dang / /g.yo med phyag rgya chen po'i ting 'dzin mchog /rnam pa kun tu bsgom zhing bgegs med par/ /chos dbyings kun mkhyen rgyal po nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni jo nang mkhan po la bstod pa shākya'i dge slong ā nandas dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa gnang ba// shrī bi dza yantu/ phun tshogs rgyal ba'i bstan la legs zhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas dges ba'i tshul khrims dri bsung can/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng mkhas pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de la 'dud/ /'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// ༈ /chos rje kun dga' rgya mtsho la bstod pa gnang ba// 'gro kun dga' bar byed pa'i blo gros lus/ /zab don nor bu'i gdengs kas mngon par spras/

/mang du thos pa'i rgya mtsho rtag gnas pa/ /mkhas mchog ltos 'gro'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas mdzad// ༈ /jo nang mkhan chen la bstod pa shlau ka gcig gnang ba ni// pra dza yantu/ legs byas bye ba'i dpal ldan zhing / /thos bsam bsgom la rtag 'grus pa/ /gcig tu brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /rin chen gsum dngos de la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di yang sa skya lo tsā bas bris// ༈ /bsgrub pa sangs rgyas dpal la bstod pa gnang ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /smin byed dbang dang rim gnyis legs bsgom pa/ /nyams rtogs dpal gyi 'byor pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /bsgrub chen sangs rgyas dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag slob mar gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes nye bar bskyang nas kyang / /thogs med 'khor bar bsags pa'i las nyon gyi/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung mtha' dag sbyangs du gsol/ /rang gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /mkha' mnyam skye dgu kun gyi legs thob te/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang bskul ba po'i don du sa skya lo tsās bris pa'o// ༈ /gu ru ratna saṃ bha ba pā dha ka/ na mo ratna sambha bā ya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ /mdun du lnga brtsegs gdan gyi steng / /bla ma rin chen sabhar bsam/ /dpral mgrin snying khar yi ge gsum/ /dkar dmar 'thing gsum mtha' skor du/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma tshe dang dpal/ /bsod nams blo gros rgyas pa'i lha/ /gang 'dod rnams kyis bskor bar bsam/ /'od zer spros bsdus bla ma dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs/ /gnyis med bstim la 'dren mchog sogs/ /thun mong tshig gis gsol ba btab/ /chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i artsa dbul/ /yan lag bdun pa lan gsum bya/ /rang gi lus srog longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge tshogs thams cad kyang /

/gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla'i tshul/ /byas la lan grangs ci rigs 'bul/ /'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba btab/ /de rjes dbang bzhi blangs nas kyang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs kyi/ /phrin las 'bad med bstsal bar bsam/ /gus 'dud drag po byas pa yis/ /bla ma 'od zhu rang la bstim/ /gdan lnga'i steng na rang nyid ni ratna sambha bar gsal ba'i/ /phyag g.yas mthil nas dgos 'dod kyi/ /char phab 'gro kun ratnar gyur/ /rang dang brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kun/ /sems dang sgyu ma rten 'brel dang / /brjod bral dbyings la mnyam par gzhag /langs nas sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /'di yang sa skya'i dge slong gang / /skad gnyis smra ba ā nandas/ /dza ba dza ba byañdza na/ /ā yuṣpu ṇḍ+ya bistā ra// ༈ /bi ru pa sā dha kaḥ /na mo gu ra be/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom la/ /mdun du dur khrod sogs kyi dbus/ /bla ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsam/ /rang nyid yi dam nga rgyal gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs/ /tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba btab/ /bla ma'i gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /ā hā lnga las 'od zer dkar/ /dmar sngo ser ljang rim bzhin 'phros/ /rang gi dpral mgrin snying lte gsang / /rim par thim pas sgo gsum gyi/ /sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa sbyangs/ /dbang bzhi bskur zhing sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las zhugs par bsam/ /mthar yang gus 'dud byas pa yis/ /mdun gyi de nyid rang la thims/ /rang yang de 'drar gyur gsal btab/ /dkyil 'khor lnga sogs tshar gcig brjod/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yig 'bru/ /rdzogs par bsam zhing kha sbyor rlung / /skor cig gzung la de rjes su/ /'og sgo 'byed 'dzum byas pa yis/ /rlung g.yos sum mdo'i me 'bar bas/ /lte ba'i aṃ sbar mas rims sregs/ /spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi babs/ /g.yas rims 'khor lo khengs nas aṃ/ /thigs gcig phog pas cher 'bar te/
